title.zh: 卷六十一 表第一 宰相上
title.raw: 卷六十一 表第一 宰相上 Volume 61 Tables 1: Chancellors 1

sentences.zh: 唐因隋舊，以三省長官為宰相，已而又以他官參議，而稱號不一，出於臨時，最後乃有同品、平章之名，然其為職業則一也。

translations.literal: Tang followed Sui precedent, taking the heads of the Three Departments as chancellors; afterward other officials were also brought in to deliberate, but their titles were not uniform and arose provisionally; finally there came designations such as tongpin and Pingzhang, yet the occupation itself was one.
translations.idiomatic: Following Sui practice, Tang treated the chiefs of the Three Departments as chancellors; later other officials joined in deliberation as well, but their titles were inconsistent and often ad hoc, until at last designations such as "same rank" and Pingzhang appeared—though the office itself remained one.

sentences.zh: 作宰相表。

translations.literal: [We] compose the chancellor table.
translations.idiomatic: Here begins the Chancellor Table.

sentences.zh: 618 武德元年戊寅

translations.literal: 618 CE, first year of the Wude reign, wuyin year.
translations.idiomatic: 618 CE, first year of the Wude reign, wuyin year.

sentences.zh: 六月甲戌，趙國公世民為尚書令，相國長史裴寂拜尚書右僕射，知政事；

translations.literal: Sixth month, jiaxu day: Duke of Zhao Shimin became Director of the Department of State Affairs; Chief Administrator of the Chancellor's Office Pei Ji was appointed Right Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs, knowing governmental affairs;
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on jiaxu, Duke of Zhao Shimin was named Director of the Department of State Affairs; Pei Ji, chief administrator of the chancellor's office, was appointed Right Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs and charged with state affairs;

sentences.zh: 相國司馬劉文靜為納言；

translations.literal: Chancellor's Office Marshal Liu Wenjing became Chief of the Palace Secretariat;
translations.idiomatic: Liu Wenjing, marshal of the chancellor's office, was appointed Chief of the Palace Secretariat;

sentences.zh: 隋民部尚書宋國公蕭瑀、相國司錄參軍竇威並為內史令。

translations.literal: Sui Minister of the Household Song Duke Xiao Yu and Chancellor's Office Registrar Dou Wei both became Directors of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: Xiao Yu, Duke of Song and former Sui Minister of the Household, and Dou Wei, registrar of the chancellor's office, were both appointed Directors of the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，世民封秦王。

translations.literal: Gengchen day: Shimin was enfeoffed as Prince of Qin.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen, Shimin was enfeoffed as Prince of Qin.

sentences.zh: 癸未，世民為西討元帥；

translations.literal: Guiwei day: Shimin became Western Campaign commander-in-chief;
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei, Shimin was made commander-in-chief of the western expedition;

sentences.zh: 壬辰，為雍州牧。

translations.literal: Renchen day: [he] became Governor of Yongzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen, he was appointed Governor of Yongzhou.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，威薨。

translations.literal: Xinchou day: Wei died.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou, Dou Wei died.

sentences.zh: 將作大匠襲陳國公竇抗本官兼納言，黃門侍郎陳叔達判納言。

translations.literal: Chief Director of Palace Construction, inheriting Duke of Chen Dou Kang's original office, additionally became Chief of the Palace Secretariat; Yellow Gate Attendant Chen Shuda acted as Chief of the Palace Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: Dou Kang, Duke of Chen and chief director of palace construction, retained his original post and was additionally named Chief of the Palace Secretariat; Yellow Gate Attendant Chen Shuda served concurrently as acting Chief of the Palace Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 八月己丑，世民為西討行軍元帥。

translations.literal: Eighth month, jichou day: Shimin became Western Campaign mobile-army commander-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on jichou, Shimin was made commander-in-chief of the western expedition field army.

sentences.zh: 戊申，文靜除名。

translations.literal: Wushen day: Wenjing was stripped of his name.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen, Liu Wenjing was dismissed and expunged from the rolls.

sentences.zh: 十月，抗罷為左武候大將軍。

translations.literal: Tenth month: Kang was removed and became General of the Left Martial Guard.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, Dou Kang was relieved and appointed General of the Left Martial Guard.

sentences.zh: 十二月壬申，秦王世民為太尉、陝東道行臺尚書令。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, renshen day: Prince of Qin Shimin became Grand Marshal and Mobile Secretariat Director of the Shaanxi East Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on renshen, Prince of Qin Shimin was named Grand Marshal and Director of the Shaanxi East Circuit Mobile Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 正月甲子，叔達兼納言。

translations.literal: First month, jiazi day: Shuda additionally [served as] Chief of the Palace Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month, on jiazi, Chen Shuda was additionally charged as Chief of the Palace Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 十月己亥，黃門侍郎、涼州總管楊恭仁遙領納言。

translations.literal: Tenth month, jihai day: Yellow Gate Attendant and Liangzhou Commander-in-Chief Yang Gongren remotely held the post of Chief of the Palace Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, on jihai, Yellow Gate Attendant and Liangzhou Commander-in-Chief Yang Gongren held the title of Chief of the Palace Secretariat in absentia.

sentences.zh: 620 三年庚辰

translations.literal: 620 CE, third year, gengchen year.
translations.idiomatic: 620 CE, third year, gengchen year.

sentences.zh: 三月甲戌，中書侍郎封德彝兼中書令。

translations.literal: Third month, jiaxu day: Secretariat Attendant Feng Deyi additionally [served as] Director of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on jiaxu, Secretariat Attendant Feng Deyi was additionally named Director of the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 四月甲寅，世民為益州道行臺尚書令。

translations.literal: Fourth month, jiayin day: Shimin became Mobile Secretariat Director of the Yizhou Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, on jiayin, Shimin was appointed Director of the Yizhou Circuit Mobile Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 正月，德彝判吏部尚書。

translations.literal: First month: Deyi acted as Minister of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month, Feng Deyi served concurrently as acting Minister of Personnel.

sentences.zh: 四月癸酉，寂為左僕射。

translations.literal: Fourth month, guiyou day: Ji became Left Vice Director.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, on guiyou, Pei Ji was appointed Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs.

sentences.zh: 十月己丑，齊王元吉為司空，世民加司徒、天策上將。

translations.literal: Tenth month, jichou day: Prince of Qi Yuanji became Minister of Works; Shimin was promoted to Minister of Education and Heavenly Strategist General.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, on jichou, Prince of Qi Li Yuanji was named Minister of Works; Shimin was promoted to Minister of Education and Heavenly Strategist General.

sentences.zh: 十月甲子，世民領左、右十二衛大將軍

translations.literal: Tenth month, jiazi day: Shimin headed the Left and Right Twelve Guard generals.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, on jiazi, Shimin took command of the generals of the Left and Right Twelve Guards.

sentences.zh: 四月癸酉，德彝為中書令；

translations.literal: Fourth month, guiyou day: Deyi became Director of the Secretariat;
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, on guiyou, Feng Deyi was appointed Director of the Secretariat;

sentences.zh: 恭仁入為吏部尚書兼中書令，檢校涼州諸軍事；

translations.literal: Gongren entered [the capital] as Minister of Personnel and additionally Director of the Secretariat, inspecting Liangzhou military affairs;
translations.idiomatic: Yang Gongren entered the capital as Minister of Personnel and concurrent Director of the Secretariat, with supervisory authority over Liangzhou military affairs;

sentences.zh: 瑀為尚書右僕射；

translations.literal: Yu became Right Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs;
translations.idiomatic: Xiao Yu was appointed Right Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs;

sentences.zh: 寂為左僕射。

translations.literal: Ji became Left Vice Director.
translations.idiomatic: Pei Ji was appointed Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs.

sentences.zh: 624 七年甲申

translations.literal: 624 CE, seventh year, jiashen year.
translations.idiomatic: 624 CE, seventh year, jiashen year.

sentences.zh: 十二月庚午，太子詹事裴矩檢校侍中。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, gengwu day: Crown Prince Household Administrator Pei Ju inspected the Palace Secretariat as acting supervisor.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on gengwu, Pei Ju, administrator of the crown prince's household, was made acting supervisor of the Palace Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 625 八年乙酉

translations.literal: 625 CE, eighth year, yiyou year.
translations.idiomatic: 625 CE, eighth year, yiyou year.

sentences.zh: 十一月辛卯，矩罷判黃門侍郎。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, xinmao day: Ju was removed from acting Yellow Gate Attendant.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on xinmao, Pei Ju was relieved of his concurrent duty as acting Yellow Gate Attendant.

sentences.zh: 庚子，天策府司馬宇文士及權檢校侍中兼太子詹事。

translations.literal: Gengzi day: Heavenly Strategist Office Marshal Yuwen Shiji provisionally inspected the Palace Secretariat and additionally served as Crown Prince Household Administrator.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi, Yuwen Shiji, marshal of the Heavenly Strategist Office, was provisionally made acting supervisor of the Palace Secretariat and concurrent administrator of the crown prince's household.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，世民加中書令，元吉加侍中。

translations.literal: Guimao day: Shimin was promoted to Director of the Secretariat; Yuanji was promoted to Palace Secretariat Attendant.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao, Shimin was promoted to Director of the Secretariat and Yuanji to Palace Secretariat Attendant.

sentences.zh: 626 九年丙戌

translations.literal: 626 CE, ninth year, bingxu year.
translations.idiomatic: 626 CE, ninth year, bingxu year.

sentences.zh: 六月癸亥，世民為皇太子。

translations.literal: Sixth month, guihai day: Shimin became crown prince.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on guihai, Shimin was established as crown prince.

sentences.zh: 七月辛卯，太子右庶子高士廉為侍中，左庶子房玄齡為中書令，蕭瑀為尚書左僕射。

translations.literal: Seventh month, xinmao day: Crown Prince Right Senior Support Gao Shilian became Palace Secretariat Attendant; Left Senior Support Fang Xuanling became Director of the Secretariat; Xiao Yu became Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, on xinmao, Gao Shilian, right senior support of the crown prince, was named Palace Secretariat Attendant; Fang Xuanling, left senior support, was named Director of the Secretariat; and Xiao Yu was appointed Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs.

sentences.zh: 恭仁罷。

translations.literal: Gongren was removed.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Gongren was dismissed.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，士及為中書令，德彝為尚書右僕射。

translations.literal: Guisi day: Shiji became Director of the Secretariat; Deyi became Right Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi, Yuwen Shiji was appointed Director of the Secretariat and Feng Deyi Right Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs.

sentences.zh: 十月庚辰，叔達、瑀坐事免。

translations.literal: Tenth month, gengchen day: Shuda and Yu were removed for offenses.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, on gengchen, Chen Shuda and Xiao Yu were dismissed for misconduct.

sentences.zh: 正月甲寅，裴寂為司空。

translations.literal: First month, jiayin day: Pei Ji became Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month, on jiayin, Pei Ji was appointed Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 二月庚申，元吉為司徒。

translations.literal: Second month, gengshen day: Yuanji became Minister of Education.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on gengshen, Li Yuanji was named Minister of Education.

sentences.zh: 六月庚申，元吉誅。

translations.literal: Sixth month, gengshen day: Yuanji was executed.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on gengshen, Li Yuanji was put to death.

sentences.zh: 627 貞觀元年丁亥

translations.literal: 627 CE, first year of the Zhenguan reign, dinghai year.
translations.idiomatic: 627 CE, first year of the Zhenguan reign, dinghai year.

sentences.zh: 六月辛丑，德彝薨。

translations.literal: Sixth month, renchen day: Deyi died.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on renchen, Feng Deyi died.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，太子少師蕭瑀為尚書左僕射。

translations.literal: Renchen day: Crown Prince Junior Preceptor Xiao Yu became Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen, Xiao Yu, junior preceptor of the crown prince, was appointed Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs.

sentences.zh: 七月壬子，吏部尚書長孫無忌為尚書右僕射。

translations.literal: Seventh month, renzi day: Minister of Personnel Zhangsun Wuji became Right Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, on renzi, Zhangsun Wuji, Minister of Personnel, was appointed Right Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs.

sentences.zh: 八月，士及檢校涼州都督。

translations.literal: Eighth month: Shiji inspected Liangzhou as area commander.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, Yuwen Shiji was made acting area commander of Liangzhou.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，士廉貶為安州大都督。

translations.literal: Wuxu day: Shilian was demoted to Area Commander of Anzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu, Gao Shilian was demoted to area commander of Anzhou.

sentences.zh: 九月辛酉，御史大夫杜淹檢校吏部尚書，參豫朝政。

translations.literal: Ninth month, xinyou day: Censor-in-Chief Du Yan inspected the Ministry of Personnel and participated in deliberations on court affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on xinyou, Censor-in-Chief Du Yan was made acting supervisor of the Ministry of Personnel and joined deliberations on court affairs.

sentences.zh: 士及罷為殿中監。

translations.literal: Shiji was removed and became Supervisor of the Palace Domestic Office.
translations.idiomatic: Yuwen Shiji was relieved and appointed supervisor of the palace domestic office.

sentences.zh: 十二月壬午，瑀罷。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, renwu day: Yu was removed.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on renwu, Xiao Yu was dismissed.

sentences.zh: 628 二年戊子

translations.literal: 628 CE, second year, wuzi year.
translations.idiomatic: 628 CE, second year, wuzi year.

sentences.zh: 正月辛亥，兵部尚書杜如晦檢校侍中，攝吏部尚書，仍總監東宮兵馬事。

translations.literal: First month, xinhai day: Minister of War Du Ruhui inspected the Palace Secretariat, acted as Minister of Personnel, and still oversaw crown prince military and horse affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month, on xinhai, Du Ruhui, Minister of War, was made acting supervisor of the Palace Secretariat, acting Minister of Personnel, and continued to oversee the crown prince's military and cavalry affairs.

sentences.zh: 無忌罷。

translations.literal: Wuji was removed.
translations.idiomatic: Zhangsun Wuji was dismissed.

sentences.zh: 庚午，刑部尚書李靖檢校中書令。

translations.literal: Gengwu day: Minister of Justice Li Jing inspected the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu, Li Jing, Minister of Justice, was made acting supervisor of the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 三月壬戌，靖為關內道行軍大總管。

translations.literal: Third month, renxu day: Jing became Grand General of the Guannei Circuit field army.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on renxu, Li Jing was appointed grand general of the Guannei Circuit field army.

sentences.zh: 七月戊申，玄齡兼太子詹事。

translations.literal: Seventh month, wushen day: Xuanling additionally [served as] Crown Prince Household Administrator.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, on wushen, Fang Xuanling was additionally named administrator of the crown prince's household.

sentences.zh: 十月庚辰，淹薨。

translations.literal: Tenth month, gengchen day: Yan died.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, on gengchen, Du Yan died.

sentences.zh: 十二月壬辰，黃門侍郎王珪守侍中。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, renchen day: Yellow Gate Attendant Wang Gui acted as Palace Secretariat Attendant.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on renchen, Yellow Gate Attendant Wang Gui served as acting Palace Secretariat Attendant.

sentences.zh: 629 三年己丑

translations.literal: 629 CE, third year, jichou year.
translations.idiomatic: 629 CE, third year, jichou year.

sentences.zh: 二月戊寅，房玄齡為尚書左僕射；

translations.literal: Second month, wuyin day: Fang Xuanling became Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs;
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on wuyin, Fang Xuanling was appointed Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs;

sentences.zh: 杜如晦為右僕射；

translations.literal: Du Ruhui became Right Vice Director;
translations.idiomatic: Du Ruhui was appointed Right Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs;

sentences.zh: 尚書右丞魏徵為祕書監，參豫朝政；

translations.literal: Right Director of the Department of State Affairs Wei Zheng became Director of the Secretariat Library, participating in deliberations on court affairs;
translations.idiomatic: Wei Zheng, right director of the Department of State Affairs, was named Director of the Secretariat Library and joined deliberations on court affairs;

sentences.zh: 靖為兵部尚書。

translations.literal: Jing became Minister of War.
translations.idiomatic: Li Jing was appointed Minister of War.

sentences.zh: 八月，靖為定襄道行軍大總督。

translations.literal: Eighth month: Jing became Grand Commander of the Dingxiang Circuit field army.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, Li Jing was made grand commander of the Dingxiang Circuit field army.

sentences.zh: 十二月癸未，如晦罷。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, guiwei day: Ruhui was removed.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on guiwei, Du Ruhui was dismissed.

sentences.zh: 正月辛未，寂免。

translations.literal: First month, xinwei day: Ji was removed.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month, on xinwei, Pei Ji was dismissed from office.

sentences.zh: 二月甲寅，珪為侍中；

translations.literal: Second month, jiayin day: Gui became Palace Secretariat Attendant;
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on jiayin, Wang Gui was appointed Palace Secretariat Attendant;

sentences.zh: 太常卿蕭瑀為御史大夫，參議朝政；

translations.literal: Court of Imperial Sacrifices Director Xiao Yu became Censor-in-Chief, deliberating on court affairs;
translations.idiomatic: Xiao Yu, director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices, was named Censor-in-Chief and joined deliberations on court affairs;

sentences.zh: 御史大夫溫彥博為中書令；

translations.literal: Censor-in-Chief Wen Yanbo became Director of the Secretariat;
translations.idiomatic: Wen Yanbo, Censor-in-Chief, was appointed Director of the Secretariat;

sentences.zh: 民部尚書戴冑檢校吏部尚書，參豫朝政。

translations.literal: Minister of the Household Dai Zhou inspected the Ministry of Personnel and participated in deliberations on court affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Dai Zhou, Minister of the Household, was made acting supervisor of the Ministry of Personnel and joined deliberations on court affairs.

sentences.zh: 七月癸酉，瑀罷為太子少傅。

translations.literal: Seventh month, guiyou day: Yu was removed and became Junior Preceptor of the Crown Prince.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, on guiyou, Xiao Yu was relieved and appointed junior preceptor of the crown prince.

sentences.zh: 八月甲寅，靖為尚書右僕射。

translations.literal: Eighth month, jiayin day: Jing became Right Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on jiayin, Li Jing was appointed Right Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs.

sentences.zh: 十一月壬戌，右衛大將軍侯君集為兵部尚書，參豫朝政。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, renxu day: Right Guard General Hou Junji became Minister of War, participating in deliberations on court affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on renxu, Hou Junji, general of the Right Guard, was named Minister of War and joined deliberations on court affairs.

sentences.zh: 631 五年辛卯

translations.literal: 631 CE, fifth year, xinmao year.
translations.idiomatic: 631 CE, fifth year, xinmao year.

sentences.zh: 632 六年壬辰

translations.literal: 632 CE, sixth year, renchen year.
translations.idiomatic: 632 CE, sixth year, renchen year.

sentences.zh: 三月，君集以喪罷。

translations.literal: Third month: Junji was removed on account of mourning.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, Hou Junji stepped down to observe mourning.

sentences.zh: 五月，徵檢校侍中。

translations.literal: Fifth month: Zheng inspected the Palace Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, Wei Zheng was made acting supervisor of the Palace Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 十月，君集起復。

translations.literal: Tenth month: Junji returned from mourning.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, Hou Junji resumed office after mourning.

sentences.zh: 633 七年癸巳

translations.literal: 633 CE, seventh year, guisi year.
translations.idiomatic: 633 CE, seventh year, guisi year.

sentences.zh: 三月戊子，珪罷為同州刺史。

translations.literal: Third month, wuzi day: Gui was removed and became prefect of Tongzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on wuzi, Wang Gui was relieved and appointed prefect of Tongzhou.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，徵為侍中。

translations.literal: Gengyin day: Zheng became Palace Secretariat Attendant.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin, Wei Zheng was appointed Palace Secretariat Attendant.

sentences.zh: 六月辛亥，冑薨。

translations.literal: Sixth month, xinhai day: Zhou died.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on xinhai, Dai Zhou died.

sentences.zh: 十一月壬辰，開府儀同三司長孫無忌為司空。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, renchen day: Honored Companion of the First Rank Zhangsun Wuji became Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on renchen, Zhangsun Wuji, honored companion of the first rank, was appointed Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 十月丙寅，詔靖三兩日一至門下、中書，平章政事。

translations.literal: Tenth month, bingyin day: An edict [ordered that] Jing come to the Palace Secretariat and Secretariat every two or three days to deliberate jointly on state affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, on bingyin, an edict directed Li Jing to attend the Palace Secretariat and Secretariat every two or three days to deliberate jointly on state affairs.

sentences.zh: 十一月辛未，靖罷為特進。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, xinwei day: Jing was removed and became specially advanced.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on xinwei, Li Jing was relieved and given the rank of specially advanced.

sentences.zh: 十二月辛丑，君集為積石道行軍總管。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, xinchou day: Junji became commander of the Jishi Circuit field army.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on xinchou, Hou Junji was appointed commander of the Jishi Circuit field army.

sentences.zh: 635 九年乙未

translations.literal: 635 CE, ninth year, yiwei year.
translations.idiomatic: 635 CE, ninth year, yiwei year.

sentences.zh: 七月辛巳，恭仁罷為雍州牧。

translations.literal: Seventh month, xinsi day: Gongren was removed and became Governor of Yongzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, on xinsi, Yang Gongren was relieved and appointed Governor of Yongzhou.

sentences.zh: 十一月壬戌，特進蕭瑀參豫朝政。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, renxu day: Specially Advanced Xiao Yu participated in deliberations on court affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on renxu, Xiao Yu, specially advanced, joined deliberations on court affairs.

sentences.zh: 二月，無忌以母喪罷。

translations.literal: Second month: Wuji was removed on account of his mother's mourning.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, Zhangsun Wuji stepped down to mourn his mother.

sentences.zh: 五月，起復。

translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, on yiyou, Cui Dunli was appointed Director of the Secretariat;

sentences.zh: 中書舍人李義府守中書侍郎，參知政事。

translations.literal: Secretariat Draftsman Li Yifu acted as Secretariat Attendant, participating in knowing governmental affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Li Yifu, draftsman of the Secretariat, served as acting Secretariat Attendant and joined in managing state affairs.

sentences.zh: 九月庚午，遂良貶潭洲都督。

translations.literal: Ninth month, gengwu day: Suiliang was demoted to area commander of Tanzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on gengwu, Chu Suiliang was demoted to area commander of Tanzhou.

sentences.zh: 十月癸丑，敦禮檢校太子詹事。

translations.literal: Tenth month, guichou day: Dunli inspected the crown prince's household as acting supervisor.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, on guichou, Cui Dunli was made acting supervisor of the crown prince's household.

sentences.zh: 656 顯慶元年丙辰

translations.literal: 656 CE, first year of the Xianqing reign, bingchen year.
translations.idiomatic: 656 CE, first year of the Xianqing reign, bingchen year.

sentences.zh: 正月甲申，志寧為太子太傅，瑗、濟並罷太子賓客。

translations.literal: First month, jiashen day: Zhining became Grand Preceptor of the Crown Prince; Yuan and Ji were both removed as crown prince guests.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month, on jiashen, Yu Zhining was named grand preceptor of the crown prince; Han Yuan and Lai Ji were both relieved as crown prince guests.

sentences.zh: 三月丙戌，戶部侍郎杜正倫為黃門侍郎、同中書門下三品。

translations.literal: Third month, bingxu day: Vice Minister of Revenue Du Zhenglun became Yellow Gate Attendant with rank equal to the Three Departments.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on bingxu, Du Zhenglun, Vice Minister of Revenue, was named Yellow Gate Attendant with rank equal to the Three Departments.

sentences.zh: 七月癸未，敦禮為太子少師、同中書門下三品。

translations.literal: Seventh month, guiwei day: Dunli became Junior Mentor of the Crown Prince with rank equal to the Three Departments.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, on guiwei, Cui Dunli was named junior mentor of the crown prince with rank equal to the Three Departments.

sentences.zh: 八月丙申，敦禮薨。

translations.literal: Eighth month, bingshen day: Dunli died.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on bingshen, Cui Dunli died.

sentences.zh: 657 二年丁巳

translations.literal: 657 CE, second year, dingsi year.
translations.idiomatic: 657 CE, second year, dingsi year.

sentences.zh: 三月癸丑，義府兼中書令，兼檢校御史大夫，仍太子賓客；

translations.literal: Third month, guichou day: Yifu additionally [served as] Director of the Secretariat and additionally inspected the Censorate, still crown prince guest;
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on guichou, Li Yifu was additionally named Director of the Secretariat and acting Censor-in-Chief, while remaining crown prince guest;

sentences.zh: 正倫兼度支尚書。

translations.literal: Zhenglun additionally [served as] Minister of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: Du Zhenglun was additionally named Minister of Revenue.

sentences.zh: 八月丁卯，瑗貶振州刺史，濟貶台州刺史。

translations.literal: Eighth month, dingmao day: Yuan was demoted to prefect of Zhenzhou; Ji was demoted to prefect of Taizhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on dingmao, Han Yuan was demoted to prefect of Zhenzhou and Lai Ji to prefect of Taizhou.

sentences.zh: 辛未，衛尉卿許敬宗為侍中。

translations.literal: Xinwei day: Court Commandant Xu Jingzong became Palace Secretariat Attendant.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei, Xu Jingzong, court commandant, was appointed Palace Secretariat Attendant.

sentences.zh: 九月庚寅，正倫兼中書令。

translations.literal: Ninth month, gengyin day: Zhenglun additionally [served as] Director of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on gengyin, Du Zhenglun was additionally named Director of the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 658 三年戊午

translations.literal: 658 CE, third year, wuwu year.
translations.idiomatic: 658 CE, third year, wuwu year.

sentences.zh: 十一月乙酉，正倫貶橫州刺史，義府貶普州刺史。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, yiyou day: Zhenglun was demoted to prefect of Hengzhou; Yifu was demoted to prefect of Puzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on yiyou, Du Zhenglun was demoted to prefect of Hengzhou and Li Yifu to prefect of Puzhou.

sentences.zh: 戊子，敬宗權檢校中書令。

translations.literal: Wuzi day: Jingzong provisionally inspected the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi, Xu Jingzong was provisionally made acting supervisor of the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，敬宗為中書令，大理卿辛茂將兼侍中。

translations.literal: Wuxu day: Jingzong became Director of the Secretariat; Court of Judicial Review Director Xin Maojiang additionally [served as] Palace Secretariat Attendant.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu, Xu Jingzong was named Director of the Secretariat; Xin Maojiang, director of the Court of Judicial Review, was additionally named Palace Secretariat Attendant.

sentences.zh: 659 四年己未

translations.literal: 659 CE, fourth year, jiwei year.
translations.idiomatic: 659 CE, fourth year, jiwei year.

sentences.zh: 四月丙辰，志寧為太子太師、同中書門下三品。

translations.literal: Fourth month, bingchen day: Zhining became Grand Preceptor of the Crown Prince with rank equal to the Three Departments.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, on bingchen, Yu Zhining was named grand preceptor of the crown prince with rank equal to the Three Departments.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，守黃門侍郎許圉師兼檢校左庶子、同中書門下三品。

translations.literal: Yichou day: Acting Yellow Gate Attendant Xu Yuanshi additionally inspected the left senior support with rank equal to the Three Departments.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou, Xu Yuanshi, acting Yellow Gate Attendant, was additionally made acting supervisor of the left senior support with rank equal to the Three Departments.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，志寧免。

translations.literal: Wuchen day: Zhining was removed.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen, Yu Zhining was dismissed from office.

sentences.zh: 五月己卯，圉師為中書侍郎同三品。

translations.literal: Fifth month, jimao day: Yuanshi became Secretariat Attendant with rank equal to the Three Departments.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on jimao, Xu Yuanshi was named Secretariat Attendant with rank equal to the Three Departments.

sentences.zh: 丙申，兵部尚書任雅相同中書門下三品，度支尚書盧承慶參知政事。

translations.literal: Bingshen day: Minister of War Ren Yaxiang received rank equal to the Three Departments; Minister of Revenue Lu Chengqing participated in knowing governmental affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen, Ren Yaxiang, Minister of War, was given rank equal to the Three Departments; Lu Chengqing, Minister of Revenue, joined in managing state affairs.

sentences.zh: 八月壬子，義府兼吏部尚書、同中書門下三品。

translations.literal: Eighth month, renzi day: Yifu additionally [served as] Minister of Personnel with rank equal to the Three Departments.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on renzi, Li Yifu was additionally named Minister of Personnel with rank equal to the Three Departments.

sentences.zh: 九月癸卯，茂將兼左庶子。

translations.literal: Ninth month, guimao day: Maojiang additionally [served as] left senior support.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on guimao, Xin Maojiang was additionally named left senior support.

sentences.zh: 十月甲辰，圉師兼右庶子。

translations.literal: Tenth month, jiachen day: Yuanshi additionally [served as] right senior support.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, on jiachen, Xu Yuanshi was additionally named right senior support.

sentences.zh: 十一月丙午，圉師為左散騎常侍，檢校侍中。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, bingwu day: Yuanshi became Left Regular Attendant and inspected the Palace Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on bingwu, Xu Yuanshi was named Left Regular Attendant and made acting supervisor of the Palace Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 戊午，茂將薨。

translations.literal: Wuwu day: Maojiang died.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu, Xin Maojiang died.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，承慶同中書門下三品。

translations.literal: Guai day: Chengqing received rank equal to the Three Departments.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai, Lu Chengqing was given rank equal to the Three Departments.

sentences.zh: 四月戊辰，無忌為揚州都督，黔州安置。

translations.literal: Fourth month, wuchen day: Wuji became area commander of Yangzhou, settled at Qianzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, on wuchen, Zhangsun Wuji was made area commander of Yangzhou and resettled at Qianzhou.

sentences.zh: 660 五年庚申

translations.literal: 660 CE, fifth year, gengshen year.
translations.idiomatic: 660 CE, fifth year, gengshen year.

sentences.zh: 七月丁卯，承慶免。

translations.literal: Seventh month, dingmao day: Chengqing was removed.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, on dingmao, Lu Chengqing was dismissed from office.

sentences.zh: 661 龍朔元年辛酉

translations.literal: 661 CE, first year of the Longshuo reign, xinyou year.
translations.idiomatic: 661 CE, first year of the Longshuo reign, xinyou year.

sentences.zh: 四月庚辰，雅相為浿江道行軍總管。

translations.literal: Fourth month, gengchen day: Yaxiang became commander of the Peijiang Circuit field army.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, on gengchen, Ren Yaxiang was appointed commander of the Peijiang Circuit field army.

sentences.zh: 662 二年壬戌

translations.literal: 662 CE, second year, renxu year.
translations.idiomatic: 662 CE, second year, renxu year.

sentences.zh: 二年甲戌，雅相薨。

translations.literal: Second year, jiaxu day: Yaxiang died.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year, on jiaxu, Ren Yaxiang died.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，敬宗為右相；

translations.literal: Bingxu day: Jingzong became right chief councillor;
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu, Xu Jingzong was named right chief councillor;

sentences.zh: 圉師為左侍極，檢校左相。

translations.literal: Yuanshi became Left Attendant-in-Chief and inspected the left chief councillor.
translations.idiomatic: Xu Yuanshi was named Left Attendant-in-Chief and made acting supervisor of the left chief councillor.

sentences.zh: 七月戊戌，義府以母喪罷。

translations.literal: Seventh month, wuxu day: Yifu was removed on account of his mother's mourning.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, on wuxu, Li Yifu stepped down to mourn his mother.

sentences.zh: 八月壬寅，敬宗為太子少師、同東西臺三品，仍知西臺事。

translations.literal: Eighth month, renyin day: Jingzong became Junior Mentor of the Crown Prince with rank equal to the Eastern and Western Terrace chiefs, still knowing Western Terrace affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on renyin, Xu Jingzong was named junior mentor of the crown prince with rank equal to the chiefs of the Eastern and Western Terraces, retaining charge of Western Terrace affairs.

sentences.zh: 九月丁丑，義府起復。

translations.literal: Ninth month, dingchou day: Yifu returned from mourning.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on dingchou, Li Yifu resumed office after mourning.

sentences.zh: 十月庚戌，西臺侍郎上官儀同東西臺三品。

translations.literal: Tenth month, gengxu day: Western Terrace Attendant Shangguan Yi received rank equal to the Eastern and Western Terraces.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, on gengxu, Shangguan Yi, Western Terrace Attendant, was given rank equal to the chiefs of the Eastern and Western Terraces.

sentences.zh: 十一月辛未，圉師貶為虔州刺史。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, xinwei day: Yuanshi was demoted to prefect of Qianzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on xinwei, Xu Yuanshi was demoted to prefect of Qianzhou.

sentences.zh: 663 三年癸亥

translations.literal: 663 CE, third year, guihai year.
translations.idiomatic: 663 CE, third year, guihai year.

sentences.zh: 正月乙丑，義府為右相。

translations.literal: First month, yichou day: Yifu became right chief councillor.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month, on yichou, Li Yifu was named right chief councillor.

sentences.zh: 四月戊子，義府流于巂州。

translations.literal: Fourth month, wuzi day: Yifu was exiled to Xizhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, on wuzi, Li Yifu was exiled to Xizhou.

sentences.zh: 664 麟德元年甲子

translations.literal: 664 CE, first year of the Linde reign, jiazi year.
translations.idiomatic: 664 CE, first year of the Linde reign, jiazi year.

sentences.zh: 八月丁亥，司列太常伯劉祥道兼右相；

translations.literal: Eighth month, dinghai day: Director of the Bureau of Ranks Liu Xiangdao additionally [served as] right chief councillor;
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on dinghai, Liu Xiangdao, director of the Bureau of Ranks, was additionally named right chief councillor;

sentences.zh: 大司憲竇德玄為司元太常伯，檢校左相。

translations.literal: Grand Censor Dou Dexuan became Director of the Bureau of Personnel, inspecting the left chief councillor.
translations.idiomatic: Dou Dexuan, grand censor, was named Director of the Bureau of Personnel and made acting supervisor of the left chief councillor.

sentences.zh: 十二月丙戌，儀被殺。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, bingxu day: Yi was killed.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on bingxu, Shangguan Yi was executed.

sentences.zh: 戊子，祥道罷為司禮太常伯。

translations.literal: Wuzi day: Xiangdao was removed and became Director of the Bureau of Rites.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi, Liu Xiangdao was relieved and appointed director of the Bureau of Rites.

sentences.zh: 太子右中護樂彥瑋檢校西臺侍郎，西臺侍郎孫處約，並同知軍國政事，尋同東西臺三品。

translations.literal: Crown Prince Right Central Guard Yue Yanwei inspected the Western Terrace Attendant; Western Terrace Attendant Sun Chuyue—both jointly knew military and state affairs, soon with rank equal to the Eastern and Western Terraces.
translations.idiomatic: Yue Yanwei, crown prince's right central guard, was made acting supervisor of the Western Terrace Attendant; Western Terrace Attendant Sun Chuyue joined him in managing military and state affairs, and soon both received rank equal to the chiefs of the Eastern and Western Terraces.

sentences.zh: 665 二年乙丑

translations.literal: 665 CE, second year, yichou year.
translations.idiomatic: 665 CE, second year, yichou year.

sentences.zh: 三月甲寅，司戎太常伯姜恪同東西臺三品。

translations.literal: Third month, jiayin day: Director of the Bureau of War Jiang Kuo received rank equal to the Eastern and Western Terraces.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on jiayin, Jiang Kuo, director of the Bureau of War, was given rank equal to the chiefs of the Eastern and Western Terraces.

sentences.zh: 四月戊辰，彥瑋、處約並罷。

translations.literal: Fourth month, wuchen day: Yanwei and Chuyue were both removed.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, on wuchen, Yue Yanwei and Sun Chuyue were both dismissed.

sentences.zh: 左侍極陸敦信檢校右相。

translations.literal: Left Attendant-in-Chief Lu Dunxin inspected the right chief councillor.
translations.idiomatic: Lu Dunxin, Left Attendant-in-Chief, was made acting supervisor of the right chief councillor.

sentences.zh: 十月壬戌，帶方州刺史劉仁軌為大司憲兼知政事，檢校太子左中護。

translations.literal: Tenth month, renxu day: Liu Rengui, area commander of Daifang, became Grand Censor and additionally knew governmental affairs, inspecting the crown prince's left central guard.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, on renxu, Liu Rengui, area commander of Daifang, was named Grand Censor, joined in managing state affairs, and made acting supervisor of the crown prince's left central guard.

sentences.zh: 666 乾封元年丙寅

translations.literal: 666 CE, first year of the Qianfeng reign, bingyin year.
translations.idiomatic: 666 CE, first year of the Qianfeng reign, bingyin year.

sentences.zh: 四月庚戌，敦信罷為大司成。

translations.literal: Fourth month, gengxu day: Dunxin was removed and became Grand Director of the Imperial Academy.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, on gengxu, Lu Dunxin was relieved and appointed grand director of the imperial academy.

sentences.zh: 七月庚午，仁軌兼右相，檢校右中護。

translations.literal: Seventh month, gengwu day: Rengui additionally [served as] right chief councillor, inspecting the right central guard.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, on gengwu, Liu Rengui was additionally named right chief councillor and made acting supervisor of the right central guard.

sentences.zh: 八月辛丑，德玄薨。

translations.literal: Eighth month, xinchou day: Dexuan died.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on xinchou, Dou Dexuan died.

sentences.zh: 十二月癸酉，勣為遼東道行軍大總管。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, guiyou day: Ji became grand commander of the Liaodong Circuit field army.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on guiyou, Li Ji was appointed grand commander of the Liaodong Circuit field army.

sentences.zh: 667 二年丁卯

translations.literal: 667 CE, second year, dingmao year.
translations.idiomatic: 667 CE, second year, dingmao year.

sentences.zh: 六月乙卯，西臺侍郎楊武戴至德、東臺侍郎李安期、司列少常伯趙仁本並同東西臺三品。

translations.literal: Sixth month, yimao day: Western Terrace Attendant Yang Wudai Zhide, Eastern Terrace Attendant Li Anqi, and Junior Director of the Bureau of Ranks Zhao Renben all received rank equal to the Eastern and Western Terraces.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on yimao, Yang Wudai Zhide, Western Terrace Attendant, Li Anqi, Eastern Terrace Attendant, and Zhao Renben, junior director of the Bureau of Ranks, were all given rank equal to the chiefs of the Eastern and Western Terraces.

sentences.zh: 東臺舍人張文瓘參知政事。

translations.literal: Eastern Terrace draftsman Zhang Wenjin participated in knowing governmental affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Wenjin, draftsman of the Eastern Terrace, joined in managing state affairs.

sentences.zh: 八月辛亥，安期罷為荊州大都督長史。

translations.literal: Eighth month, xinhai day: Anqi was removed and became chief administrator of the Jingzhou area command.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on xinhai, Li Anqi was relieved and appointed chief administrator of the Jingzhou area command.

sentences.zh: 668 總章元年戊辰

translations.literal: 668 CE, first year of the Zongzhang reign, wuchen year.
translations.idiomatic: 668 CE, first year of the Zongzhang reign, wuchen year.

sentences.zh: 正月壬子，仁軌為遼東道行軍副總管兼安撫大使、浿江道行軍總管。

translations.literal: First month, renzi day: Rengui became deputy grand commander of the Liaodong Circuit field army and concurrently pacification commissioner, and commander of the Peijiang Circuit field army.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month, on renzi, Liu Rengui was named deputy grand commander of the Liaodong Circuit field army and concurrent pacification commissioner, and commander of the Peijiang Circuit field army.

sentences.zh: 四月辛巳，武薨。

translations.literal: Fourth month, xinsi day: Wu died.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, on xinsi, Yang Wu died.

sentences.zh: 十二月甲戌，恪檢校左相，司平太常伯閻立本守右相。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, jiaxu day: Kuo inspected the left chief councillor; Director of the Bureau of Justice Yan Liben acted as right chief councillor.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on jiaxu, Jiang Kuo was made acting supervisor of the left chief councillor; Yan Liben, director of the Bureau of Justice, served as acting right chief councillor.

sentences.zh: 是歲，勣加太子太師。

translations.literal: That year: Ji was promoted to Grand Preceptor of the Crown Prince.
translations.idiomatic: That year, Li Ji was promoted to grand preceptor of the crown prince.

sentences.zh: 669 二年己巳

translations.literal: 669 CE, second year, jisi year.
translations.idiomatic: 669 CE, second year, jisi year.

sentences.zh: 二月辛酉，文瓘為東臺侍郎，右肅機李敬玄為西臺侍郎，並同東西臺三品。

translations.literal: Second month, xinyou day: Wenjin became Eastern Terrace Attendant; Right Attendant-in-Chief Li Jingxuan became Western Terrace Attendant; both received rank equal to the Eastern and Western Terraces.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on xinyou, Zhang Wenjin was named Eastern Terrace Attendant; Li Jingxuan, Right Attendant-in-Chief, was named Western Terrace Attendant; both received rank equal to the chiefs of the Eastern and Western Terraces.

sentences.zh: 三月丙戌，東臺侍郎郝處俊同東西臺三品。

translations.literal: Third month, bingxu day: Eastern Terrace Attendant Hao Chujun received rank equal to the Eastern and Western Terraces.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on bingxu, Hao Chujun, Eastern Terrace Attendant, was given rank equal to the chiefs of the Eastern and Western Terraces.

sentences.zh: 十二月戊申，勣薨。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, wushen day: Ji died.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on wushen, Li Ji died.

sentences.zh: 正月丁丑，仁軌以金紫光祿大夫致仕。

translations.literal: First month, dingchou day: Rengui retired with the rank of Golden Grand Master of Splendid Happiness.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month, on dingchou, Liu Rengui retired with the rank of Golden Grand Master of Splendid Happiness.

sentences.zh: 三月壬辰，敬宗以特進致仕。

translations.literal: Third month, renchen day: Jingzong retired as specially advanced.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on renchen, Xu Jingzong retired with the rank of specially advanced.

sentences.zh: 四月己酉，敬玄以喪免。

translations.literal: Fourth month, jiyou day: Jingxuan was removed on account of mourning.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, on jiyou, Li Jingxuan was dismissed to observe mourning.

sentences.zh: 七月戊子，敬玄起復。

translations.literal: Seventh month, wuzi day: Jingxuan returned from mourning.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, on wuzi, Li Jingxuan resumed office after mourning.

sentences.zh: 閏九月甲寅，恪為涼州道行軍大總管。

translations.literal: Intercalary ninth month, jiayin day: Kuo became grand commander of the Liangzhou Circuit field army.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary ninth month, on jiayin, Jiang Kuo was appointed grand commander of the Liangzhou Circuit field army.

sentences.zh: 十月乙未，仁本罷為左肅機。

translations.literal: Tenth month, yiwei day: Renben was removed and became Left Attendant-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, on yiwei, Zhao Renben was relieved and named Left Attendant-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 671 二年辛未

translations.literal: 671 CE, second year, xinwei year.
translations.idiomatic: 671 CE, second year, xinwei year.

sentences.zh: 恪為侍中，立本為中書令。

translations.literal: Kuo became Palace Secretariat Attendant; Liben became Director of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: Jiang Kuo was named Palace Secretariat Attendant and Yan Liben Director of the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 九月丙申，徐王元禮薨。

translations.literal: Ninth month, bingshen day: Prince of Xu Yuanli died.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on bingshen, Prince of Xu Li Yuanli died.

sentences.zh: 672 三年壬申

translations.literal: 672 CE, third year, renshen year.
translations.idiomatic: 672 CE, third year, renshen year.

sentences.zh: 二月己卯，恪薨。

translations.literal: Second month, jimao day: Kuo died.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on jimao, Jiang Kuo died.

sentences.zh: 十月，文瓘為大理卿。

translations.literal: Tenth month: Wenjin became Director of the Court of Judicial Review.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, Zhang Wenjin was appointed director of the Court of Judicial Review.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，至德為戶部尚書，敬玄吏部侍郎，處俊中書侍郎。

translations.literal: Yihai day: Zhide became Minister of Revenue; Jingxuan Vice Minister of Personnel; Chujun Secretariat Attendant.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai, Yang Zhide was named Minister of Revenue; Li Jingxuan Vice Minister of Personnel; and Hao Chujun Secretariat Attendant.

sentences.zh: 十二月，劉仁軌為太子左庶子、同中書門下三品。

translations.literal: Twelfth month: Liu Rengui became Crown Prince Left Senior Support with rank equal to the Three Departments.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, Liu Rengui was named crown prince left senior support with rank equal to the chiefs of the Three Departments.

sentences.zh: 673 四年癸酉

translations.literal: 673 CE, fourth year, guiyou year.
translations.idiomatic: 673 CE, fourth year, guiyou year.

sentences.zh: 十月壬午，立本薨。

translations.literal: Tenth month, renwu day: Liben died.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, on renwu, Yan Liben died.

sentences.zh: 674 上元元年甲戌

translations.literal: 674 CE, first year of the Shangyuan reign, jiaxu year.
translations.idiomatic: 674 CE, first year of the Shangyuan reign, jiaxu year.

sentences.zh: 二月壬午，仁軌為雞林道行軍大總管。

translations.literal: Second month, renwu day: Rengui became grand commander of the Silla Circuit field army.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on renwu, Liu Rengui was appointed grand commander of the Silla Circuit field army.

sentences.zh: 675 二年乙亥

translations.literal: 675 CE, second year, yihai year.
translations.idiomatic: 675 CE, second year, yihai year.

sentences.zh: 八月庚子，文瓘為侍中，處俊為中書令，並同中書門下三品。

translations.literal: Eighth month, gengzi day: Wenjin became Palace Secretariat Attendant; Chujun became Director of the Secretariat; both with rank equal to the Three Departments.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on gengzi, Zhang Wenjin was named Palace Secretariat Attendant and Hao Chujun Director of the Secretariat, both with rank equal to the Three Departments.

sentences.zh: 仁軌為尚書左僕射，至德為右僕射，敬玄為吏部尚書。

translations.literal: Rengui became Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs; Zhide Right Vice Director; Jingxuan Minister of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Rengui was appointed Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs; Yang Zhide Right Vice Director; and Li Jingxuan Minister of Personnel.

sentences.zh: 676 儀鳳元年丙子

translations.literal: 676 CE, first year of the Yifeng reign, bingzi year.
translations.idiomatic: 676 CE, first year of the Yifeng reign, bingzi year.

sentences.zh: 三月癸卯，黃門侍郎來恆、中書侍郎薛元超並同中書門下三品。

translations.literal: Third month, guimao day: Yellow Gate Attendant Lai Heng and Secretariat Attendant Xue Yuanchao both received rank equal to the Three Departments.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on guimao, Lai Heng, Yellow Gate Attendant, and Xue Yuanchao, Secretariat Attendant, were both made Associates of the Secretariat-Chancellery Third Rank.

sentences.zh: 四月甲寅，中書侍郎李義琰同中書門下三品。

translations.literal: Fourth month, jiayin day: Secretariat Attendant Li Yiyan received rank equal to the Three Departments.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, on jiayin, Li Yiyan, Secretariat Attendant, was given rank equal to the Three Departments.

sentences.zh: 六月癸亥，黃門侍郎高智周同中書門下三品。

translations.literal: Sixth month, guihai day: Yellow Gate Attendant Gao Zhizhou received rank equal to the Three Departments.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on guihai, Gao Zhizhou, Yellow Gate Attendant, was given rank equal to the Three Departments.

sentences.zh: 十一月庚寅，敬玄為中書令。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, gengyin day: Jingxuan became Director of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on gengyin, Li Jingxuan was appointed Director of the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 十二月丙午，恆為河南道大使，元超河北道大使。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, bingwu day: Heng became commissioner of the Henan Circuit; Yuanchao commissioner of the Hebei Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on bingwu, Lai Heng was named commissioner-in-chief of the Henan Circuit and Xue Yuanchao commissioner-in-chief of the Hebei Circuit.

sentences.zh: 677 二年丁丑

translations.literal: 677 CE, second year, dingchou year.
translations.idiomatic: 677 CE, second year, dingchou year.

sentences.zh: 三月癸亥，處俊、智周為太子左庶子，義琰為右庶子。

translations.literal: Third month, guihai day: Chujun and Zhizhou became crown prince left senior supports; Yiyan right senior support.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on guihai, Hao Chujun and Gao Zhizhou were named crown prince left senior supports and Li Yiyan right senior support.

sentences.zh: 四月，太子左庶子張大安同中書門下三品。

translations.literal: Fourth month: Crown Prince Left Senior Support Zhang Da'an received rank equal to the Three Departments.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, Zhang Da'an, crown prince left senior support, was given rank equal to the Three Departments.

sentences.zh: 八月辛亥，仁軌為洮河軍鎮守使。

translations.literal: Eighth month, xinhai day: Rengui became garrison commander of the Taohe Army.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on xinhai, Liu Rengui was appointed garrison commander of the Taohe Army.

sentences.zh: 678 三年戊寅

translations.literal: 678 CE, third year, wuyin year.
translations.idiomatic: 678 CE, third year, wuyin year.

sentences.zh: 正月丙子，敬玄為洮河道行軍大總管兼安撫大使，檢校鄯州都督。

translations.literal: First month, bingzi day: Jingxuan became grand commander of the Taohe Circuit field army and concurrent pacification commissioner, inspecting the area commander of Shanzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month, on bingzi, Li Jingxuan was named grand commander of the Taohe Circuit field army and concurrent pacification commissioner, with acting supervisory authority over the Shanzhou area command.

sentences.zh: 九月癸亥，文瓘薨。

translations.literal: Ninth month, guihai day: Wenjin died.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on guihai, Zhang Wenjin died.

sentences.zh: 十一月壬子，恆薨。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, renzi day: Heng died.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on renzi, Lai Heng died.

sentences.zh: 679 調露元年己卯

translations.literal: 679 CE, first year of the Tiaolu reign, jimao year.
translations.idiomatic: 679 CE, first year of the Tiaolu reign, jimao year.

sentences.zh: 正月庚戌，至德薨。

translations.literal: First month, gengxu day: Zhide died.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month, on gengxu, Yang Zhide died.

sentences.zh: 四月辛酉，處俊為侍中，元超檢校太子左庶子。

translations.literal: Fourth month, xinyou day: Chujun became Palace Secretariat Attendant; Yuanchao inspected crown prince left senior support.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, on xinyou, Hao Chujun was named Palace Secretariat Attendant and Xue Yuanchao was made acting supervisor of the crown prince left senior support.

sentences.zh: 十一月戊寅，智周罷為御史大夫。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, wuyin day: Zhizhou was removed and became Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on wuyin, Gao Zhizhou was relieved and appointed Censor-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 680 永隆元年庚辰

translations.literal: 680 CE, first year of the Yonglong reign, gengchen year.
translations.idiomatic: 680 CE, first year of the Yonglong reign, gengchen year.

sentences.zh: 四月戊辰，中書侍郎王德真、黃門侍郎裴炎、崔知溫並同中書門下三品。

translations.literal: Fourth month, wuchen day: Secretariat Attendant Wang Dezhen, Yellow Gate Attendant Pei Yan, and Cui Zhiwen all received rank equal to the Three Departments.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, on wuchen, Wang Dezhen, Secretariat Attendant, and Yellow Gate Attendants Pei Yan and Cui Zhiwen were all made Associates of the Secretariat-Chancellery Third Rank.

sentences.zh: 八月丁巳，敬玄貶衡州刺史。

translations.literal: Eighth month, dingsi day: Jingxuan was demoted to prefect of Hengzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on dingsi, Li Jingxuan was demoted to prefect of Hengzhou.

sentences.zh: 己巳，大安貶普州刺史。

translations.literal: Jisi day: Da'an was demoted to prefect of Puzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi, Zhang Da'an was demoted to prefect of Puzhou.

sentences.zh: 九月甲申，德真罷為相王府長史。

translations.literal: Ninth month, jiashen day: Dezhen was removed and became chief administrator of the Prince of Xiang's household.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on jiashen, Wang Dezhen was relieved and appointed chief administrator of the Prince of Xiang's household.

sentences.zh: 681 開耀元年辛巳

translations.literal: 681 CE, first year of the Kaiyao reign, xinsi year.
translations.idiomatic: 681 CE, first year of the Kaiyao reign, xinsi year.

sentences.zh: 三月辛卯，仁軌兼太子少傅，處俊罷為太子少保。

translations.literal: Third month, xinmao day: Rengui additionally [served as] Junior Preceptor of the Crown Prince; Chujun was removed as Junior Guardian of the Crown Prince.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on xinmao, Liu Rengui was additionally named junior preceptor of the crown prince; Hao Chujun was relieved as junior guardian of the crown prince.

sentences.zh: 七月甲午，仁軌罷左僕射，以太子少傅同中書門下三品。

translations.literal: Seventh month, jiawu day: Rengui was removed as left vice director and, as junior preceptor of the crown prince, received rank equal to the Three Departments.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, on jiawu, Liu Rengui was relieved as left vice director and, as junior preceptor of the crown prince, given rank equal to the Three Departments.

sentences.zh: 閏七月丁未，元超、知溫並守中書令，炎為侍中。

translations.literal: Intercalary seventh month, dingwei day: Yuanchao and Zhiwen both acted as Director of the Secretariat; Yan became Palace Secretariat Attendant.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary seventh month, on dingwei, Xue Yuanchao and Cui Zhiwen both served as acting Director of the Secretariat; Pei Yan was named Palace Secretariat Attendant.

sentences.zh: 682 永淳元年壬午

translations.literal: 682 CE, first year of the Yongchun reign, renwu year.
translations.idiomatic: 682 CE, first year of the Yongchun reign, renwu year.

sentences.zh: 四月丙寅，仁軌為京副留守，元超、炎留輔皇太子。

translations.literal: Fourth month, bingyin day: Rengui became deputy capital guardian of Jing; Yuanchao and Yan remained to assist the crown prince.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, on bingyin, Liu Rengui was named deputy capital guardian of Jing; Xue Yuanchao and Pei Yan remained to assist the crown prince.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，黃門侍郎郭待舉、兵部侍郎岑長倩、祕書員外少監郭正一、吏部侍郎魏玄同並與中書門下同承受進止平章事。

translations.literal: Dinghai day: Yellow Gate Attendant Guo Daiju, Vice Minister of War Cen Changqian, acting junior supervisor of the Secretariat Guo Zhengyi, and Vice Minister of Personnel Wei Xuantong all jointly received directives with the Secretariat and Palace Secretariat and deliberated jointly on state affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai, Guo Daiju, Yellow Gate Attendant, Cen Changqian, Vice Minister of War, Guo Zhengyi, acting junior supervisor of the Secretariat, and Wei Xuantong, Vice Minister of Personnel, all jointly received directives with the Secretariat and Palace Secretariat and deliberated jointly on state affairs.

sentences.zh: 十月丙寅，黃門侍郎劉景先同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: Tenth month, bingyin day: Yellow Gate Attendant Liu Jingxian deliberated jointly on state affairs with the Secretariat and Palace Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, on bingyin, Liu Jingxian, Yellow Gate Attendant, joined the Secretariat and Palace Secretariat in deliberating jointly on state affairs.

sentences.zh: 683 弘道元年癸未

translations.literal: 683 CE, first year of the Hongdao reign, guiwei year.
translations.idiomatic: 683 CE, first year of the Hongdao reign, guiwei year.

sentences.zh: 三月庚子，義琰以銀青光祿大夫致仕。

translations.literal: Third month, gengzi day: Yiyan retired with the rank of Silver Grand Master of Splendid Light.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on gengzi, Li Yiyan retired with the rank of Silver Grand Master of Splendid Light.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，知溫薨。

translations.literal: Guichou day: Zhiwen died.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou, Cui Zhiwen died.

sentences.zh: 四月壬申，待舉檢校太子右庶子，正一為中書侍郎，並同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: Fourth month, renshen day: Daiju inspected crown prince right senior support; Zhengyi became Secretariat Attendant; both deliberated jointly on state affairs with the Secretariat and Palace Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, on renshen, Guo Daiju was made acting supervisor of the crown prince right senior support; Guo Zhengyi was named Secretariat Attendant; both joined the Secretariat and Palace Secretariat in deliberating jointly on state affairs.

sentences.zh: 七月甲辰，元超罷。

translations.literal: Seventh month, jiachen day: Yuanchao was removed.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, on jiachen, Xue Yuanchao was dismissed.

sentences.zh: 十一月戊申，炎、正一、景先兼於東宮平章事。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, wushen day: Yan, Zhengyi, and Jingxian additionally deliberated jointly on state affairs at the Eastern Palace.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on wushen, Pei Yan, Guo Zhengyi, and Liu Jingxian additionally joined in deliberating jointly on state affairs at the eastern palace.

sentences.zh: 十二月甲戌，仁軌罷為左僕射、京師留守。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, jiaxu day: Rengui was removed and became left vice director and capital guardian of Jing.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on jiaxu, Liu Rengui was relieved and appointed left vice director and capital guardian of Jing.

sentences.zh: 炎為中書令。

translations.literal: Yan became Director of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: Pei Yan was named Director of the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，景先守侍中，長倩兵部尚書，待舉左散騎常侍，玄同黃門侍郎，並同中書門下三品。

translations.literal: Wuyin day: Jingxian acted as Palace Secretariat Attendant; Changqian Minister of War; Daiju Left Regular Attendant; Xuantong Yellow Gate Attendant; all with rank equal to the Three Departments.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin, Liu Jingxian served as acting Palace Secretariat Attendant; Cen Changqian was named Minister of War; Guo Daiju Left Regular Attendant; Wei Xuantong Yellow Gate Attendant; all with rank equal to the Three Departments.

sentences.zh: 癸未，正一罷為國子祭酒。

translations.literal: Guiwei day: Zhengyi was removed and became Director of the Directorate of Education.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei, Guo Zhengyi was relieved and appointed director of the directorate of education.

sentences.zh: 十二月庚午，韓王元嘉為太尉，霍王元軌為司徒，舒王元名為司空。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, gengwu day: Prince of Han Yuanjia became Grand Marshal; Prince of Huo Yuan Gui Minister of Education; Prince of Shu Yuanming Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on gengwu, Prince of Han Li Yuanjia was named Grand Marshal; Prince of Huo Li Yuan Gui Minister of Education; and Prince of Shu Li Yuanming Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 正月癸巳，左散騎常侍韋弘敏為太府卿、同中書門下三品。

translations.literal: First month, guisi day: Left Regular Attendant Wei Hongmin became Director of the Court of the Imperial Treasury with rank equal to the Three Departments.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month, on guisi, Wei Hongmin, Left Regular Attendant, was named director of the Court of the Imperial Treasury with rank equal to the Three Departments.

sentences.zh: 二月丁丑，檢校豫王府長史、太常卿王德真為侍中。

translations.literal: Second month, dingchou day: Wang Dezhen, acting chief administrator of the Prince of Yu's household and Court of Imperial Sacrifices Director, became Palace Secretariat Attendant.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on dingchou, Wang Dezhen, acting chief administrator of the Prince of Yu's household and director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices, was named Palace Secretariat Attendant.

sentences.zh: 中書侍郎、豫王府司馬劉禕之為中書侍郎、同中書門下三品。

translations.literal: Secretariat Attendant and Prince of Yu's Office Marshal Liu Yizhi became Secretariat Attendant with rank equal to the Three Departments.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Yizhi, Secretariat Attendant and marshal of the Prince of Yu's office, was named Secretariat Attendant with rank equal to the Three Departments.

sentences.zh: 閏五月甲子，禮部尚書武承嗣為太常卿、同中書門下三品。

translations.literal: Intercalary fifth month, jiazi day: Minister of Rites Wu Chengsi became Court of Imperial Sacrifices Director with rank equal to the Three Departments.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary fifth month, on jiazi, Wu Chengsi, Minister of Rites, was named Court of Imperial Sacrifices Director with rank equal to the Three Departments.

sentences.zh: 八月丙午，承嗣罷為禮部尚書。

translations.literal: Eighth month, bingwu day: Chengsi was removed and became Minister of Rites.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on bingwu, Wu Chengsi was relieved and appointed Minister of Rites.

sentences.zh: 十月丁亥，鳳閣舍人李景諶同鳳閣鸞臺平章事，左肅政臺御史大夫騫味道檢校內史、同鳳閣鸞臺三品。

translations.literal: Tenth month, dinghai day: Phoenix Pavilion draftsman Li Jingchen deliberated jointly on state affairs with the Phoenix and Crane Pavilions; Left Attendant Censor-in-Chief Su Weidao inspected the Inner Secretariat with rank equal to the Phoenix and Crane Pavilions.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, on dinghai, Li Jingchen, Phoenix Pavilion draftsman, joined the Phoenix and Crane Pavilions in deliberating jointly on state affairs; Su Weidao, Left Attendant Censor-in-Chief, was made acting supervisor of the Inner Secretariat with rank equal to the Phoenix and Crane Pavilions.

sentences.zh: 丙申，炎被殺。

translations.literal: Bingshen day: Yan was killed.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen, Pei Yan was executed.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，景先貶辰州刺史，弘敏貶汾州刺史，景諶罷守司賓少卿。

translations.literal: Dingyou day: Jingxian was demoted to prefect of Chenzhou; Hongmin demoted to prefect of Fenzhou; Jingchen was removed and acted as Director of the Court of Imperial Banquets.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou, Liu Jingxian was demoted to prefect of Chenzhou; Wei Hongmin to prefect of Fenzhou; and Li Jingchen was relieved and served as acting director of the Court of Imperial Banquets.

sentences.zh: 守右史沈君諒、著作郎崔詧並為正諫大夫、同鳳閣鸞臺平章事。

translations.literal: Acting Right Historiographer Shen Junliang and Compilation Director Cui Cha both became Grand Remonstrance Masters and deliberated jointly on state affairs with the Phoenix and Crane Pavilions.
translations.idiomatic: Shen Junliang, acting right historiographer, and Cui Cha, compilation director, were both named grand remonstrance masters and joined the Phoenix and Crane Pavilions in deliberating jointly on state affairs.

sentences.zh: 十一月丁卯，待舉罷為左庶子。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, dingmao day: Daiju was removed and became left senior support.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on dingmao, Guo Daiju was relieved and appointed left senior support.

sentences.zh: 鸞臺侍郎韋方質守鳳閣侍郎、同鳳閣鸞臺平章事。

translations.literal: Crane Pavilion Attendant Wei Fangzhi acted as Phoenix Pavilion Attendant and deliberated jointly on state affairs with the Phoenix and Crane Pavilions.
translations.idiomatic: Wei Fangzhi, Crane Pavilion Attendant, served as acting Phoenix Pavilion Attendant and joined the Phoenix and Crane Pavilions in deliberating jointly on state affairs.

sentences.zh: 685 垂拱元年乙酉

translations.literal: 685 CE, first year of the Chuigong reign, yiyou year.
translations.idiomatic: 685 CE, first year of the Chuigong reign, yiyou year.

sentences.zh: 正月戊辰，仁軌薨。

translations.literal: First month, wuchen day: Rengui died.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month, on wuchen, Liu Rengui died.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，味道守內史、同三品。

translations.literal: Gengxu day: Weidao acted as Inner Secretariat [director] with rank equal to the Three Departments.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu, Su Weidao served as acting director of the Inner Secretariat with rank equal to the Three Departments.

sentences.zh: 二月乙巳，承嗣同鳳閣鸞臺三品。

translations.literal: Second month, yisi day: Chengsi received rank equal to the Phoenix and Crane Pavilions.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on yisi, Wu Chengsi was given rank equal to the chiefs of the Phoenix and Crane Pavilions.

sentences.zh: 君諒罷。

translations.literal: Junliang was removed.
translations.idiomatic: Shen Junliang was dismissed.

sentences.zh: 右肅政臺御史大夫韋思謙、秋官尚書裴居道並同鳳閣鸞臺三品。

translations.literal: Right Attendant Censor-in-Chief Wei Siqian and Minister of Punishments Pei Judao both received rank equal to the Phoenix and Crane Pavilions.
translations.idiomatic: Wei Siqian, Right Attendant Censor-in-Chief, and Pei Judao, Minister of Punishments, were both given rank equal to the chiefs of the Phoenix and Crane Pavilions.

sentences.zh: 三月辛酉，承嗣罷，詧使河北，罷。

translations.literal: Third month, xinyou day: Chengsi was removed; Cha was sent to Hebei and removed.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on xinyou, Wu Chengsi was dismissed; Cui Cha was dispatched to Hebei and relieved.

sentences.zh: 四月丙子，味道貶青州刺史。

translations.literal: Fourth month, bingzi day: Weidao was demoted to prefect of Qingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, on bingzi, Su Weidao was demoted to prefect of Qingzhou.

sentences.zh: 五月丙午，居道為內史。

translations.literal: Fifth month, bingwu day: Judao became Inner Secretariat [director].
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on bingwu, Pei Judao was named director of the Inner Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 丁未，德真罷為同州刺史，其日流象州。

translations.literal: Dingwei day: Dezhen was removed and became prefect of Tongzhou; that same day [he] was exiled to Xiangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei, Wang Dezhen was relieved and appointed prefect of Tongzhou; that same day he was exiled to Xiangzhou.

sentences.zh: 己酉，冬官尚書蘇良嗣守納言。

translations.literal: Jiyou day: Minister of Winter Works Su Liangsi acted as Chief of the Palace Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou, Su Liangsi, Minister of Winter Works, served as acting Chief of the Palace Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 壬申，方質同鳳閣鸞臺三品。

translations.literal: Renshen day: Fangzhi received rank equal to the Phoenix and Crane Pavilions.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen, Wei Fangzhi was given rank equal to the chiefs of the Phoenix and Crane Pavilions.

sentences.zh: 六月，天官尚書韋待價同鳳閣鸞臺三品。

translations.literal: Sixth month: Minister of Heaven Wei Daizhi received rank equal to the Phoenix and Crane Pavilions.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, Wei Daizhi, Minister of Heaven, was given rank equal to the chiefs of the Phoenix and Crane Pavilions.

sentences.zh: 七月己酉，玄同自文昌左丞遷鸞臺侍郎。

translations.literal: Seventh month, jiyou day: Xuantong moved from left director of the Wenchang Bureau to Crane Pavilion Attendant.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, on jiyou, Wei Xuantong was transferred from left director of the Wenchang Bureau to Crane Pavilion Attendant.

sentences.zh: 十一月癸卯，待價為燕然道行軍大總管。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, guimao day: Daizhi became grand commander of the Yanran Circuit field army.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on guimao, Wei Daizhi was appointed grand commander of the Yanran Circuit field army.

sentences.zh: 十一月丙辰，元嘉自殺，元軌流黔州。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, bingchen day: Yuanjia killed himself; Yuan Gui was exiled to Qianzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on bingchen, Li Yuanjia took his own life; Li Yuan Gui was exiled to Qianzhou.

sentences.zh: 三月丙辰，玄同為地官尚書。

translations.literal: Third month, bingchen day: Xuantong became Minister of Earth.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on bingchen, Wei Xuantong was named Minister of Earth.

sentences.zh: 四月庚辰，長倩為內史。

translations.literal: Fourth month, gengchen day: Changqian became Inner Secretariat [director].
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, on gengchen, Cen Changqian was named director of the Inner Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 五月丙午，居道為納言。

translations.literal: Fifth month, bingwu day: Judao became Chief of the Palace Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on bingwu, Pei Judao was named Chief of the Palace Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 六月辛未，良嗣守文昌左相、同鳳閣鸞臺三品，待價守文昌右相。

translations.literal: Sixth month, xinwei day: Liangsi acted as left chief councillor of Wenchang with rank equal to the Phoenix and Crane Pavilions; Daizhi acted as right chief councillor of Wenchang.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on xinwei, Su Liangsi served as acting left chief councillor of Wenchang with rank equal to the Phoenix and Crane Pavilions; Wei Daizhi served as acting right chief councillor of Wenchang.

sentences.zh: 己卯，思謙守納言。

translations.literal: Jimao day: Siqian acted as Chief of the Palace Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao, Wei Siqian served as acting Chief of the Palace Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 687 三年丁亥

translations.literal: 687 CE, third year, dinghai year.
translations.idiomatic: 687 CE, third year, dinghai year.

sentences.zh: 三月乙丑，思謙以太中大夫致仕。

translations.literal: Third month, yichou day: Siqian retired with the rank of Grand Master of Splendid Happiness.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on yichou, Wei Siqian retired with the rank of Grand Master of Splendid Happiness.

sentences.zh: 四月壬戌，居道為納言。

translations.literal: Fourth month, renxu day: Judao became Chief of the Palace Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, on renxu, Pei Judao was named Chief of the Palace Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 五月丙寅，夏官侍郎張光輔為鳳閣侍郎、同鳳閣鸞臺平章事。

translations.literal: Fifth month, bingyin day: Vice Minister of Summer Zhang Guangfu became Phoenix Pavilion Attendant and deliberated jointly on state affairs with the Phoenix and Crane Pavilions.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on bingyin, Zhang Guangfu, Vice Minister of Summer, was named Phoenix Pavilion Attendant and joined the Phoenix and Crane Pavilions in deliberating jointly on state affairs.

sentences.zh: 庚午，禕之被殺。

translations.literal: Gengwu day: Yizhi was killed.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu, Liu Yizhi was executed.

sentences.zh: 八月壬子，玄同兼檢校納言。

translations.literal: Eighth month, renzi day: Xuantong additionally inspected the Palace Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on renzi, Wei Xuantong was additionally made acting supervisor of the Palace Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 十二月壬辰，待價為安息道行軍大總管。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, renchen day: Daizhi became grand commander of the Anxi Circuit field army.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on renchen, Wei Daizhi was appointed grand commander of the Anxi Circuit field army.

sentences.zh: 688 四年戊子

translations.literal: 688 CE, fourth year, wuzi year.
translations.idiomatic: 688 CE, fourth year, wuzi year.

sentences.zh: 九月丁卯，左肅政臺御史大夫騫味道、夏官侍郎王本立並同鳳閣鸞臺平章事。

translations.literal: Ninth month, dingmao day: Left Attendant Censor-in-Chief Su Weidao and Vice Minister of Summer Wang Benli both deliberated jointly on state affairs with the Phoenix and Crane Pavilions.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on dingmao, Su Weidao, Left Attendant Censor-in-Chief, and Wang Benli, Vice Minister of Summer, joined the Phoenix and Crane Pavilions in deliberating jointly on state affairs.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，光輔為諸軍節度，長倩為後軍大總管，討越王貞。

translations.literal: Bingchen day: Guangfu became commander of all armies; Changqian became grand general of the rear army, to suppress Prince of Yue Zhen.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen, Zhang Guangfu was named commander of all armies; Cen Changqian was made grand general of the rear army to suppress Li Zhen, Prince of Yue.

sentences.zh: 十二月己亥，味道被殺。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, jihai day: Weidao was killed.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on jihai, Su Weidao was executed.

sentences.zh: 689 載初元年己丑

translations.literal: 689 CE, first year of the Zaichu reign, jichou year.
translations.idiomatic: 689 CE, first year of the Zaichu reign, jichou year.

sentences.zh: 二月甲寅，方質守地官尚書。

translations.literal: Second month, jiayin day: Fangzhi acted as Minister of Earth.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on jiayin, Wei Fangzhi served as acting Minister of Earth.

sentences.zh: 三月甲寅，本立守左肅政臺御史大夫。

translations.literal: Third month, jiayin day: Benli acted as Left Attendant Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on jiayin, Wang Benli served as acting Left Attendant Censor-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 甲子，光輔守納言。

translations.literal: Jiazi day: Guangfu acted as Chief of the Palace Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi, Zhang Guangfu served as acting Chief of the Palace Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，天官尚書武承嗣為納言，光輔守內史。

translations.literal: Guiyou day: Minister of Heaven Wu Chengsi became Chief of the Palace Secretariat; Guangfu acted as Inner Secretariat [director].
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou, Wu Chengsi, Minister of Heaven, was named Chief of the Palace Secretariat; Zhang Guangfu served as acting director of the Inner Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 五月丙辰，待價為安息道行軍總管。

translations.literal: Fifth month, bingchen day: Daizhi became commander of the Anxi Circuit field army.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on bingchen, Wei Daizhi was appointed commander of the Anxi Circuit field army.

sentences.zh: 七月丙子，待價流繡州。

translations.literal: Seventh month, bingzi day: Daizhi was exiled to Xiuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, on bingzi, Wei Daizhi was exiled to Xiuzhou.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，本立同鳳閣鸞臺三品。

translations.literal: Wuyin day: Benli received rank equal to the Phoenix and Crane Pavilions.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin, Wang Benli was given rank equal to the chiefs of the Phoenix and Crane Pavilions.

sentences.zh: 八月甲申，光輔被殺。

translations.literal: Eighth month, jiashen day: Guangfu was killed.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on jiashen, Zhang Guangfu was executed.

sentences.zh: 閏九月甲午，玄同被殺。

translations.literal: Intercalary ninth month, jiawu day: Xuantong was killed.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary ninth month, on jiawu, Wei Xuantong was executed.

sentences.zh: 十月丁卯，春官尚書范履冰、鳳閣侍郎邢文偉並同鳳閣鸞臺平章事。

translations.literal: Tenth month, dingmao day: Minister of Spring Fan Lubing and Phoenix Pavilion Attendant Xing Wenwei both deliberated jointly on state affairs with the Phoenix and Crane Pavilions.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, on dingmao, Fan Lubing, Minister of Spring, and Xing Wenwei, Phoenix Pavilion Attendant, joined the Phoenix and Crane Pavilions in deliberating jointly on state affairs.

sentences.zh: 正月丁巳，元名為司徒。

translations.literal: First month, dingsi day: Yuanming became Minister of Education.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month, on dingsi, Li Yuanming was named Minister of Education.

sentences.zh: 一月戊子，承嗣為文昌左相，長倩為文昌右相，並同鳳閣鸞臺三品。

translations.literal: First month, wuzi day: Chengsi became left chief councillor of Wenchang; Changqian right chief councillor of Wenchang; both with rank equal to the Phoenix and Crane Pavilions.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month, on wuzi, Wu Chengsi was named left chief councillor of Wenchang and Cen Changqian right chief councillor of Wenchang, both with rank equal to the Phoenix and Crane Pavilions.

sentences.zh: 良嗣為特進，本立罷為地官尚書，文偉守內史，鳳閣侍郎武攸寧納言，居道為太子少保。

translations.literal: Liangsi became specially advanced; Benli was removed and became Minister of Earth; Wenwei acted as Inner Secretariat [director]; Phoenix Pavilion Attendant Wu Youning Chief of the Palace Secretariat; Judao Junior Guardian of the Crown Prince.
translations.idiomatic: Su Liangsi was made specially advanced; Wang Benli was relieved and appointed Minister of Earth; Xing Wenwei served as acting director of the Inner Secretariat; Wu Youning, Phoenix Pavilion Attendant, was named Chief of the Palace Secretariat; and Pei Judao junior guardian of the crown prince.

sentences.zh: 甲午，方質流于儋州。

translations.literal: Jiawu day: Fangzhi was exiled to Danzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu, Wei Fangzhi was exiled to Danzhou.

sentences.zh: 三月丁亥，良嗣薨。

translations.literal: Third month, dinghai day: Liangsi died.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on dinghai, Su Liangsi died.

sentences.zh: 四月丁巳，履冰被殺。

translations.literal: Fourth month, dingsi day: Lubing was killed.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, on dingsi, Fan Lubing was executed.

sentences.zh: 八月甲寅，居道下獄死。

translations.literal: Eighth month, jiayin day: Judao died in prison.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on jiayin, Pei Judao died in prison.

sentences.zh: 九月丙戌，給事中傅游藝為鸞臺侍郎、同鳳閣鸞臺平章事，司賓卿史務滋守納言，鳳閣侍郎宗秦客檢校納言。

translations.literal: Ninth month, bingxu day: Draftsman Fu Youyi became Crane Pavilion Attendant and deliberated jointly on state affairs with the Phoenix and Crane Pavilions; Court of Imperial Banquets Director Shi Wuzi acted as Chief of the Palace Secretariat; Phoenix Pavilion Attendant Zong Qinke inspected the Palace Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on bingxu, Fu Youyi, draftsman, was named Crane Pavilion Attendant and joined the Phoenix and Crane Pavilions in deliberating jointly on state affairs; Shi Wuzi, director of the Court of Imperial Banquets, served as acting Chief of the Palace Secretariat; and Zong Qinke, Phoenix Pavilion Attendant, was made acting supervisor of the Palace Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 十月甲子，秦客貶遵化尉。

translations.literal: Tenth month, jiazi day: Qinke was demoted to captain of Zunhua.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, on jiazi, Zong Qinke was demoted to captain of Zunhua.

sentences.zh: 辛未，文偉貶珍州刺史。

translations.literal: Xinwei day: Wenwei was demoted to prefect of Zhenzhou.
