translations.idiomatic: On xinwei, Xing Wenwei was demoted to prefect of Zhenzhou.

sentences.zh: 七月辛巳，元名流和州。

translations.literal: Seventh month, xinsi day: Yuanming was exiled to Hezhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, on xinsi, Li Yuanming was exiled to Hezhou.

sentences.zh: 一月庚子，務滋自殺。

translations.literal: First month, gengzi day: Wuzi killed himself.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month, on gengzi, Shi Wuzi took his own life.

sentences.zh: 五月丁亥，長倩為武威道行軍大總管。

translations.literal: Fifth month, dinghai day: Changqian became grand commander of the Wuwei Circuit field army.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on dinghai, Cen Changqian was appointed grand commander of the Wuwei Circuit field army.

sentences.zh: 六月庚戌，鸞臺侍郎樂思晦，鳳閣侍郎任知古，左肅政臺御史大夫格輔元為地官尚書，並同鳳閣鸞臺平章事。

translations.literal: Sixth month, gengxu day: Crane Pavilion Attendant Yue Sihui, Phoenix Pavilion Attendant Ren Zhigu, and Left Attendant Censor-in-Chief Ge Fuyuan, Minister of Earth, all received rank equal to the Phoenix and Crane Pavilions in deliberating jointly on state affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on gengxu, Yue Sihui, Crane Pavilion Attendant, Ren Zhigu, Phoenix Pavilion Attendant, and Ge Fuyuan, Left Attendant Censor-in-Chief and Minister of Earth, all joined the Phoenix and Crane Pavilions in deliberating jointly on state affairs.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，長倩為輔國大將軍。

translations.literal: Guimao day: Changqian became Assistant State-supporting Grand General.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao, Cen Changqian was named assistant state-supporting grand general.

sentences.zh: 八月戊申，攸寧罷為左羽林衛大將軍。

translations.literal: Eighth month, wushen day: Youning was removed and became General of the Left Feathered Forest Guard.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on wushen, Wu Youning was relieved and appointed general of the Left Feathered Forest Guard.

sentences.zh: 夏官尚書歐陽通為司禮卿，兼判納言事。

translations.literal: Minister of Summer Ouyang Tong became Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices, concurrently adjudicating Palace Secretariat affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Ouyang Tong, Minister of Summer, was named director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices with concurrent adjudication of Palace Secretariat affairs.

sentences.zh: 九月壬辰，游藝自殺。

translations.literal: Ninth month, renchen day: Youyi killed himself.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on renchen, Fu Youyi took his own life.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，攸寧守納言，冬官侍郎裴行本，洛州司馬狄仁傑守地官侍郎，並同鳳閣鸞臺平章事。

translations.literal: Guisi day: Youning acted as Chief of the Palace Secretariat; Vice Minister of Winter Pei Xingben and Luozhou Marshal Di Renjie acted as Vice Minister of Earth; all deliberated jointly on state affairs with the Phoenix and Crane Pavilions.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi, Wu Youning served as acting Chief of the Palace Secretariat; Pei Xingben, Vice Minister of Winter, and Di Renjie, Luozhou marshal, served as acting Vice Ministers of Earth; all joined the Phoenix and Crane Pavilions in deliberating jointly on state affairs.

sentences.zh: 十月己酉，長倩、輔元、通被殺。

translations.literal: Tenth month, jiyou day: Changqian, Fuyuan, and Tong were killed.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, on jiyou, Cen Changqian, Ge Fuyuan, and Ouyang Tong were executed.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，思晦被殺。

translations.literal: Renxu day: Sihui was killed.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu, Yue Sihui was executed.

sentences.zh: 692 長壽元年壬辰

translations.literal: 692 CE, first year of the Changshou reign, renchen year.
translations.idiomatic: 692 CE, first year of the Changshou reign, renchen year.

sentences.zh: 一月戊辰，夏官尚書楊執柔同鳳閣鸞臺平章事。

translations.literal: First month, wuchen day: Minister of Summer Yang Zhirou deliberated jointly on state affairs with the Phoenix and Crane Pavilions.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month, on wuchen, Yang Zhirou, Minister of Summer, joined the Phoenix and Crane Pavilions in deliberating jointly on state affairs.

sentences.zh: 庚午，知古貶江夏令，行本流嶺南，仁傑貶彭澤令。

translations.literal: Gengwu day: Zhigu was demoted to magistrate of Jiangxia; Xingben exiled to Lingnan; Renjie demoted to magistrate of Pengze.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu, Ren Zhigu was demoted to magistrate of Jiangxia; Pei Xingben was exiled to Lingnan; and Di Renjie was demoted to magistrate of Pengze.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，司刑卿李游道為冬官尚書、同鳳閣鸞臺平章事。

translations.literal: Gengchen day: Director of Punishments Li Youdao became Minister of Winter and deliberated jointly on state affairs with the Phoenix and Crane Pavilions.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen, Li Youdao, director of punishments, was named Minister of Winter and joined the Phoenix and Crane Pavilions in deliberating jointly on state affairs.

sentences.zh: 二月戊午，秋官尚書袁智弘同鳳閣鸞臺平章事。

translations.literal: Second month, wuwu day: Minister of Autumn Yuan Zhihong deliberated jointly on state affairs with the Phoenix and Crane Pavilions.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on wuwu, Yuan Zhihong, Minister of Autumn, joined the Phoenix and Crane Pavilions in deliberating jointly on state affairs.

sentences.zh: 八月戊寅，承嗣罷為特進，攸寧罷為冬官尚書，執柔罷守地官尚書。

translations.literal: Eighth month, wuyin day: Chengsi was removed and became specially advanced; Youning was removed and became Minister of Winter; Zhirou was removed and acted as Minister of Earth.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on wuyin, Wu Chengsi was relieved and made specially advanced; Wu Youning was relieved and appointed Minister of Winter; and Yang Zhirou was relieved and served as acting Minister of Earth.

sentences.zh: 司賓卿崔神基、秋官侍郎崔元綜、夏官侍郎李昭德、權檢校天官侍郎姚璹、守容州都督檢校地官侍郎李元素並同鳳閣鸞臺平章事。

translations.literal: Court of Imperial Banquets Director Cui Shenji, Vice Minister of Autumn Cui Yuanzong, Vice Minister of Summer Li Zhaode, acting supervisor of Heaven Yao Shuo, and acting Vice Minister of Earth Li Yuansu, area commander of Rongzhou, all deliberated jointly on state affairs with the Phoenix and Crane Pavilions.
translations.idiomatic: Cui Shenji, director of the Court of Imperial Banquets, Cui Yuanzong, Vice Minister of Autumn, Li Zhaode, Vice Minister of Summer, Yao Shuo, acting supervisor of Heaven, and Li Yuansu, acting Vice Minister of Earth and area commander of Rongzhou, all joined the Phoenix and Crane Pavilions in deliberating jointly on state affairs.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，營繕大匠王璿守夏官尚書、同鳳閣鸞臺平章事。

translations.literal: Xinsi day: Chief Director of Construction Wang Xuan acted as Minister of Summer and deliberated jointly on state affairs with the Phoenix and Crane Pavilions.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi, Wang Xuan, chief director of construction, served as acting Minister of Summer and joined the Phoenix and Crane Pavilions in deliberating jointly on state affairs.

sentences.zh: 九月辛丑，璹罷為司賓少卿。

translations.literal: Ninth month, xinchou day: Shuo was removed and became Director of the Court of Imperial Banquets.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on xinchou, Yao Shuo was relieved and appointed director of the Court of Imperial Banquets.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，游道、智弘、神基、元素、璿並流嶺南。

translations.literal: Guichou day: Youdao, Zhihong, Shenji, Yuansu, and Xuan were all exiled to Lingnan.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou, Li Youdao, Yuan Zhihong, Cui Shenji, Li Yuansu, and Wang Xuan were all exiled to Lingnan.

sentences.zh: 693 二年癸巳

translations.literal: 693 CE, second year, guisi year.
translations.idiomatic: 693 CE, second year, guisi year.

sentences.zh: 一月庚子，夏官侍郎婁師德同鳳閣鸞臺平章事。

translations.literal: First month, gengzi day: Vice Minister of Summer Lou Shide deliberated jointly on state affairs with the Phoenix and Crane Pavilions.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month, on gengzi, Lou Shide, Vice Minister of Summer, joined the Phoenix and Crane Pavilions in deliberating jointly on state affairs.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，昭德為夏官侍郎。

translations.literal: Yimao day: Zhaode became Vice Minister of Summer.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao, Li Zhaode was named Vice Minister of Summer.

sentences.zh: 九月癸丑，文昌右丞韋巨源，秋官侍郎陸元方為鸞臺侍郎，並同鳳閣鸞臺平章事。

translations.literal: Ninth month, guichou day: Right director of Wenchang Wei Juyuan and Vice Minister of Autumn Lu Yuanfang became Crane Pavilion Attendant; both deliberated jointly on state affairs with the Phoenix and Crane Pavilions.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on guichou, Wei Juyuan, right director of Wenchang, and Lu Yuanfang, Vice Minister of Autumn, were named Crane Pavilion Attendants and joined the Phoenix and Crane Pavilions in deliberating jointly on state affairs.

sentences.zh: 司賓卿豆盧欽望守內史。

translations.literal: Court of Imperial Banquets Director Dou Lu Qinwang acted as Inner Secretariat [director].
translations.idiomatic: Dou Lu Qinwang, director of the Court of Imperial Banquets, served as acting director of the Inner Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 694 延載元年甲午

translations.literal: 694 CE, first year of the Yanzai reign, jiawu year.
translations.idiomatic: 694 CE, first year of the Yanzai reign, jiawu year.

sentences.zh: 二月甲午，師德為秋官尚書，充河源、積石、懷遠等軍營田大使。

translations.literal: Second month, jiawu day: Shide became Minister of Autumn and served as commissioner for garrison agriculture of the Heyuan, Jishi, and Huaiyuan armies.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on jiawu, Lou Shide was named Minister of Autumn and appointed commissioner for garrison agriculture of the Heyuan, Jishi, and Huaiyuan armies.

sentences.zh: 三月甲申，昭德為檢校內史，鳳閣舍人蘇味道為鳳閣侍郎、同鳳閣鸞臺平章事，昭德為朔方道行軍長史，味道為司馬。

translations.literal: Third month, jiashen day: Zhaode became acting supervisor of the Inner Secretariat; Phoenix Pavilion draftsman Su Weidao became Phoenix Pavilion Attendant and deliberated jointly on state affairs with the Phoenix and Crane Pavilions; Zhaode became chief administrator of the Shuofang Circuit field army; Weidao marshal of the army.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on jiashen, Li Zhaode was made acting supervisor of the Inner Secretariat; Su Weidao, Phoenix Pavilion draftsman, was named Phoenix Pavilion Attendant and joined the Phoenix and Crane Pavilions in deliberating jointly on state affairs; Zhaode was named chief administrator of the Shuofang Circuit field army and Weidao army marshal.

sentences.zh: 四月壬戌，夏官尚書、武威道大總管王孝傑同鳳閣鸞臺三品。

translations.literal: Fourth month, renxu day: Minister of Summer and Grand Commander of the Wuwei Circuit Wang Xiaojie received rank equal to the Phoenix and Crane Pavilions.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, on renxu, Wang Xiaojie, Minister of Summer and grand commander of the Wuwei Circuit, was given rank equal to the chiefs of the Phoenix and Crane Pavilions.

sentences.zh: 七月癸未，嵩岳山人武什方為正諫大夫、同鳳閣鸞臺平章事。

translations.literal: Seventh month, guiwei day: Mount Song recluse Wu Shifang became Grand Remonstrance Master and deliberated jointly on state affairs with the Phoenix and Crane Pavilions.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, on guiwei, Wu Shifang, a recluse of Mount Song, was named grand remonstrance master and joined the Phoenix and Crane Pavilions in deliberating jointly on state affairs.

sentences.zh: 八月，什方乞歸山，遣之。

translations.literal: Eighth month: Shifang begged to return to the mountains; [the court] sent him away.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, Wu Shifang asked to return to the mountains and was dismissed to go.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，孝傑為瀚海道行軍總管。

translations.literal: Wuchen day: Xiaojie became commander of the Hanhai Circuit field army.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen, Wang Xiaojie was appointed commander of the Hanhai Circuit field army.

sentences.zh: 己巳，姚璹守納言，左肅政臺御史大夫楊再思為鸞臺侍郎，洛州司馬杜景佺檢校鳳閣侍郎，並同鳳閣鸞臺平章事。

translations.literal: Jisi day: Yao Shuo acted as Chief of the Palace Secretariat; Left Attendant Censor-in-Chief Yang Zaisi became Crane Pavilion Attendant; Luozhou Marshal Du Jingqian inspected the Phoenix Pavilion Attendant; all deliberated jointly on state affairs with the Phoenix and Crane Pavilions.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi, Yao Shuo served as acting Chief of the Palace Secretariat; Yang Zaisi, Left Attendant Censor-in-Chief, was named Crane Pavilion Attendant; Du Jingqian, Luozhou marshal, was made acting supervisor of the Phoenix Pavilion Attendant; all joined the Phoenix and Crane Pavilions in deliberating jointly on state affairs.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，元綜流于振州。

translations.literal: Wuyin day: Yuanzong was exiled to Zhenzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin, Cui Yuanzong was exiled to Zhenzhou.

sentences.zh: 九月壬寅，昭德貶南賓尉。

translations.literal: Ninth month, renyin day: Zhaode was demoted to captain of Nanbin.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on renyin, Li Zhaode was demoted to captain of Nanbin.

sentences.zh: 十月壬申，文昌右丞李元素守鳳閣侍郎，右肅政臺御史中丞周允元檢校鳳閣侍郎，並同鳳閣鸞臺平章事。

translations.literal: Tenth month, renshen day: Right director of Wenchang Li Yuansu acted as Phoenix Pavilion Attendant; Right Attendant Censor Vice Commissioner Zhou Yun yuan inspected Phoenix Pavilion Attendant; both deliberated jointly on state affairs with the Phoenix and Crane Pavilions.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, on renshen, Li Yuansu, right director of Wenchang, served as acting Phoenix Pavilion Attendant; Zhou Yun yuan, Right Attendant censor vice commissioner, was made acting supervisor of the Phoenix Pavilion Attendant; both joined the Phoenix and Crane Pavilions in deliberating jointly on state affairs.

sentences.zh: 695 萬歲登封元年乙未

translations.literal: 695 CE, first year of the Wansui Dengfeng reign, yiwei year.
translations.idiomatic: 695 CE, first year of the Wansui Dengfeng reign, yiwei year.

sentences.zh: 正月戊子，欽望貶趙州刺史，巨源鄜州刺史，景佺溱州刺史，味道集州刺史，元方綏州刺史。

translations.literal: First month, wuzi day: Qinwang demoted to prefect of Zhao; Juyuan to prefect of Bin; Jingqian to prefect of Zhen; Weidao to prefect of Ji; Yuanfang to prefect of Sui.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month, on wuzi, Dou Lu Qinwang was demoted to prefect of Zhao; Wei Juyuan to prefect of Bin; Du Jingqian to prefect of Zhen; Su Weidao to prefect of Ji; and Lu Yuanfang to prefect of Sui.

sentences.zh: 丙午，孝傑為朔方道行軍總管。

translations.literal: Bingwu day: Xiaojie became commander of the Shuofang Circuit field army.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu, Wang Xiaojie was appointed commander of the Shuofang Circuit field army.

sentences.zh: 二月丙辰，允元薨。

translations.literal: Second month, bingchen day: Yun yuan died.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on bingchen, Zhou Yun yuan died.

sentences.zh: 七月辛酉，孝傑為肅邊道行軍大總管。

translations.literal: Seventh month, xinyou day: Xiaojie became grand commander of the Subian Circuit field army.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, on xinyou, Wang Xiaojie was appointed grand commander of the Subian Circuit field army.

sentences.zh: 696 萬歲通天元年丙申

translations.literal: 696 CE, first year of the Wansui Tongtian reign, bingshen year.
translations.idiomatic: 696 CE, first year of the Wansui Tongtian reign, bingshen year.

sentences.zh: 一月甲寅，師德為左肅政臺御史大夫、肅邊道行軍總管。

translations.literal: First month, jiayin day: Shide became Left Attendant Censor-in-Chief and grand commander of the Subian Circuit field army.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month, on jiayin, Lou Shide was named Left Attendant Censor-in-Chief and grand commander of the Subian Circuit field army.

sentences.zh: 三月壬寅，孝傑免。

translations.literal: Third month, renyin day: Xiaojie was removed.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on renyin, Wang Xiaojie was dismissed.

sentences.zh: 四月癸酉，檢校夏官侍郎孫元亨同鳳閣鸞臺平章事。

translations.literal: Fourth month, guiyou day: Acting Vice Minister of Summer Sun Yuanheng deliberated jointly on state affairs with the Phoenix and Crane Pavilions.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, on guiyou, Sun Yuanheng, acting Vice Minister of Summer, joined the Phoenix and Crane Pavilions in deliberating jointly on state affairs.

sentences.zh: 庚子，師德貶原州司馬。

translations.literal: Gengzi day: Shide was demoted to marshal of Yuanzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi, Lou Shide was demoted to marshal of Yuanzhou.

sentences.zh: 七月辛亥，璹為榆關道安撫副大使。

translations.literal: Seventh month, xinhai day: Shuo became deputy pacification commissioner of the Yuguang Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, on xinhai, Yao Shuo was named deputy pacification commissioner of the Yuguang Circuit.

sentences.zh: 九月庚申，并州長史王方慶為鸞臺侍郎，殿中監李道廣，並同鳳閣鸞臺平章事。

translations.literal: Ninth month, gengshen day: Bingzhou Chief Administrator Wang Fangqing became Crane Pavilion Attendant; Palace Domestic Office Supervisor Li Daoguang; both deliberated jointly on state affairs with the Phoenix and Crane Pavilions.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on gengshen, Wang Fangqing, chief administrator of Bingzhou, was named Crane Pavilion Attendant; Li Daoguang, palace domestic office supervisor; both joined the Phoenix and Crane Pavilions in deliberating jointly on state affairs.

sentences.zh: 十月己卯，方慶為鳳閣侍郎。

translations.literal: Tenth month, jimao day: Fangqing became Phoenix Pavilion Attendant.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, on jimao, Wang Fangqing was named Phoenix Pavilion Attendant.

sentences.zh: 697 神功元年丁酉

translations.literal: 697 CE, first year of the Shengong reign, dingyou year.
translations.idiomatic: 697 CE, first year of the Shengong reign, dingyou year.

sentences.zh: 正月壬戌，元素、元亨被殺。

translations.literal: First month, renxu day: Yuansu and Yuanheng were killed.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month, on renxu, Li Yuansu and Sun Yuanheng were executed.

sentences.zh: 甲子，師德守鳳閣侍郎、同鳳閣鸞臺平章事。

translations.literal: Jiazi day: Shide acted as Phoenix Pavilion Attendant and deliberated jointly on state affairs with the Phoenix and Crane Pavilions.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi, Lou Shide served as acting Phoenix Pavilion Attendant and joined the Phoenix and Crane Pavilions in deliberating jointly on state affairs.

sentences.zh: 四月癸酉，前益州大都督府長史王及善為內史。

translations.literal: Fourth month, guiyou day: Former chief administrator of the Yizhou area command Wang Jishan became Inner Secretariat [director].
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, on guiyou, Wang Jishan, former chief administrator of the Yizhou area command, was named director of the Inner Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 五月癸卯，師德為清邊道行軍副大總管。

translations.literal: Fifth month, guimao day: Shide became deputy grand commander of the Qingbian Circuit field army.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on guimao, Lou Shide was appointed deputy grand commander of the Qingbian Circuit field army.

sentences.zh: 六月己卯，尚方少監宗楚客檢校夏官侍郎、同鳳閣鸞臺平章事。

translations.literal: Sixth month, jimao day: Assistant Director of the Imperial Manufactories Zong Chuke inspected Vice Minister of Summer and deliberated jointly on state affairs with the Phoenix and Crane Pavilions.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on jimao, Zong Chuke, assistant director of the imperial manufactories, was made acting supervisor of the Vice Minister of Summer and joined the Phoenix and Crane Pavilions in deliberating jointly on state affairs.

sentences.zh: 戊子，承嗣、春官尚書武三思並同鳳閣鸞臺三品。

translations.literal: Wuzi day: Chengsi and Minister of Spring Wu Sansi both received rank equal to the Phoenix and Crane Pavilions.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi, Wu Chengsi and Wu Sansi, Minister of Spring, were both given rank equal to the chiefs of the Phoenix and Crane Pavilions.

sentences.zh: 道廣兼檢校洛州長史。

translations.literal: Daoguang additionally inspected the Luozhou chief administrator.
translations.idiomatic: Li Daoguang was additionally made acting supervisor of the Luozhou chief administrator.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，師德安撫河北。

translations.literal: Xinmao day: Shide pacified Hebei.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao, Lou Shide was sent to pacify Hebei.

sentences.zh: 七月丁酉，承嗣、三思並罷。

translations.literal: Seventh month, dingyou day: Chengsi and Sansi were both removed.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, on dingyou, Wu Chengsi and Wu Sansi were both dismissed.

sentences.zh: 八月丙戌，璹罷為益州長史。

translations.literal: Eighth month, bingxu day: Shuo was removed and became chief administrator of Yizhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on bingxu, Yao Shuo was relieved and appointed chief administrator of Yizhou.

sentences.zh: 庚子，仁傑兼納言，三思檢校內史，欽望自太子宮尹為文昌右相、同鳳閣鸞臺三品。

translations.literal: Gengzi day: Renjie additionally [served as] Chief of the Palace Secretariat; Sansi inspected the Inner Secretariat; Qinwang moved from crown prince palace intendant to right chief councillor of Wenchang with rank equal to the Phoenix and Crane Pavilions.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi, Di Renjie was additionally named Chief of the Palace Secretariat; Wu Sansi was made acting supervisor of the Inner Secretariat; and Dou Lu Qinwang, from crown prince palace intendant, was named right chief councillor of Wenchang with rank equal to the Phoenix and Crane Pavilions.

sentences.zh: 九月甲子，攸寧同鳳閣鸞臺三品。

translations.literal: Ninth month, jiazi day: Youning received rank equal to the Phoenix and Crane Pavilions.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on jiazi, Wu Youning was given rank equal to the chiefs of the Phoenix and Crane Pavilions.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，仁傑為河北道副元帥，檢校納言。

translations.literal: Wuyin day: Renjie became deputy commander-in-chief of the Hebei Circuit and inspected the Palace Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin, Di Renjie was named deputy commander-in-chief of the Hebei Circuit and made acting supervisor of the Palace Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，師德守納言。

translations.literal: Gengxu day: Shide acted as Chief of the Palace Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu, Lou Shide served as acting Chief of the Palace Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 十月癸卯，仁傑為河北道安撫大使。

translations.literal: Tenth month, guimao day: Renjie became Hebei Circuit pacification commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, on guimao, Di Renjie was named Hebei Circuit pacification commissioner.

sentences.zh: 閏十月甲寅，仁傑為鸞臺侍郎，景佺為鳳閣侍郎，並同鳳閣鸞臺平章事。

translations.literal: Intercalary tenth month, jiayin day: Renjie became Crane Pavilion Attendant; Jingqian Phoenix Pavilion Attendant; both deliberated jointly on state affairs with the Phoenix and Crane Pavilions.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary tenth month, on jiayin, Di Renjie was named Crane Pavilion Attendant and Du Jingqian Phoenix Pavilion Attendant; both joined the Phoenix and Crane Pavilions in deliberating jointly on state affairs.

sentences.zh: 698 聖曆元年戊戌

translations.literal: 698 CE, first year of the Shengli reign, wuxu year.
translations.idiomatic: 698 CE, first year of the Shengli reign, wuxu year.

sentences.zh: 正月丙寅，楚客罷為文昌左丞。

translations.literal: First month, bingyin day: Chuke was removed and became left director of Wenchang.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month, on bingyin, Zong Chuke was relieved and appointed left director of Wenchang.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，道廣罷為汴州刺史。

translations.literal: Dinghai day: Daoguang was removed and became prefect of Bianzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai, Li Daoguang was relieved and appointed prefect of Bianzhou.

sentences.zh: 二月乙未，欽望罷為太子賓客。

translations.literal: Second month, yiwei day: Qinwang was removed and became crown prince guest.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on yiwei, Dou Lu Qinwang was relieved and appointed crown prince guest.

sentences.zh: 三月甲戌，師德為納言。

translations.literal: Third month, jiaxu day: Shide became Chief of the Palace Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on jiaxu, Lou Shide was named Chief of the Palace Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 四月辛丑，師德為隴右諸軍大使，仍檢校河西營田事。

translations.literal: Fourth month, xinchou day: Shide became commissioner of the Longyou armies and still inspected Hexi garrison agriculture.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, on xinchou, Lou Shide was named commissioner of the Longyou armies and retained acting supervisory authority over Hexi garrison agriculture.

sentences.zh: 七月辛未，景佺罷為秋官尚書。

translations.literal: Seventh month, xinwei day: Jingqian was removed and became Minister of Autumn.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, on xinwei, Du Jingqian was relieved and appointed Minister of Autumn.

sentences.zh: 八月甲午，方慶罷為麟臺監，修國史。

translations.literal: Eighth month, jiawu day: Fangqing was removed and became director of the Imperial Library, compiling the national history.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on jiawu, Wang Fangqing was relieved and appointed director of the Imperial Library to compile the national history.

sentences.zh: 庚子，三思檢校內史，仁傑兼納言。

translations.literal: Gengzi day: Sansi inspected the Inner Secretariat; Renjie additionally [served as] Chief of the Palace Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi, Wu Sansi was made acting supervisor of the Inner Secretariat; Di Renjie was additionally named Chief of the Palace Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 九月甲子，夏官尚書武攸寧同鳳閣鸞臺三品。

translations.literal: Ninth month, jiazi day: Minister of Summer Wu Youning received rank equal to the Phoenix and Crane Pavilions.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on jiazi, Wu Youning, Minister of Summer, was given rank equal to the chiefs of the Phoenix and Crane Pavilions.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，仁傑為河北道行軍副元帥，檢校納言。

translations.literal: Wuyin day: Renjie became deputy field commander of the Hebei Circuit and inspected the Palace Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin, Di Renjie was named deputy field commander of the Hebei Circuit and made acting supervisor of the Palace Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，試天官侍郎蘇味道為鳳閣侍郎、同鳳閣鸞臺平章事。

translations.literal: Xinsi day: Acting Vice Minister of Heaven Su Weidao became Phoenix Pavilion Attendant and deliberated jointly on state affairs with the Phoenix and Crane Pavilions.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi, Su Weidao, acting Vice Minister of Heaven, was named Phoenix Pavilion Attendant and joined the Phoenix and Crane Pavilions in deliberating jointly on state affairs.

sentences.zh: 十月癸卯，狄仁傑為河北道安撫大使。

translations.literal: Tenth month, guimao day: Di Renjie became Hebei Circuit pacification commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, on guimao, Di Renjie was named Hebei Circuit pacification commissioner.

sentences.zh: 夏官侍郎姚元崇，麟臺少監監修國史、知鳳閣侍郎李嶠，同鳳閣鸞臺平章事。

translations.literal: Vice Minister of Summer Yao Yuanchong, Junior Director of the Imperial Library compiling the national history and knowing Phoenix Pavilion Attendant Li Jiao, deliberated jointly on state affairs with the Phoenix and Crane Pavilions.
translations.idiomatic: Yao Yuanchong, Vice Minister of Summer, and Li Jiao, junior director of the Imperial Library compiling the national history and acting Phoenix Pavilion Attendant, joined the Phoenix and Crane Pavilions in deliberating jointly on state affairs.

sentences.zh: 699 二年己亥

translations.literal: 699 CE, second year, jihai year.
translations.idiomatic: 699 CE, second year, jihai year.

sentences.zh: 臘月戊子，檢校左肅政臺御史中丞吉頊為天官侍郎，右臺魏元忠為鳳閣侍郎，並同鳳閣鸞臺平章事。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, wuzi day: Acting Left Attendant Censor Vice Commissioner Ji Xu became Vice Minister of Heaven; Right Terrace Wei Yuanzhong Phoenix Pavilion Attendant; both deliberated jointly on state affairs with the Phoenix and Crane Pavilions.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on wuzi, Ji Xu, acting Left Attendant censor vice commissioner, was named Vice Minister of Heaven; Wei Yuanzhong, Right Terrace, Phoenix Pavilion Attendant; both joined the Phoenix and Crane Pavilions in deliberating jointly on state affairs.

sentences.zh: 二月庚申，武攸寧罷為冬官尚書。

translations.literal: Second month, gengshen day: Wu Youning was removed and became Minister of Winter.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on gengshen, Wu Youning was relieved and appointed Minister of Winter.

sentences.zh: 三月甲戌，師德為納言。

translations.literal: Third month, jiaxu day: Shide became Chief of the Palace Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on jiaxu, Lou Shide was named Chief of the Palace Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 四月壬辰，魏元忠檢校并州大都督府長史、天兵軍大總管，師德副之。

translations.literal: Fourth month, renchen day: Wei Yuanzhong inspected the chief administrator of the Bingzhou area command and grand commander of the Tianbing Army; Shide served as his deputy.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, on renchen, Wei Yuanzhong was made acting supervisor of the chief administrator of the Bingzhou area command and grand commander of the Tianbing Army, with Lou Shide as his deputy.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，師德充隴右諸軍大使。

translations.literal: Renyin day: Shide served as commissioner of the Longyou armies.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin, Lou Shide was appointed commissioner of the Longyou armies.

sentences.zh: 八月庚子，再思罷為左肅政臺御史大夫。

translations.literal: Eighth month, gengzi day: Zaisi was removed and became Left Attendant Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on gengzi, Yang Zaisi was relieved and appointed Left Attendant Censor-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 及善為文昌左相、同鳳閣鸞臺平章事，太子宮尹欽望為文昌右相、同鳳閣鸞臺三品。

translations.literal: Jishan became left chief councillor of Wenchang and deliberated jointly on state affairs with the Phoenix and Crane Pavilions; crown prince palace intendant Qinwang became right chief councillor of Wenchang with rank equal to the Phoenix and Crane Pavilions.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Jishan was named left chief councillor of Wenchang and joined the Phoenix and Crane Pavilions in deliberating jointly on state affairs; Dou Lu Qinwang, crown prince palace intendant, was named right chief councillor of Wenchang with rank equal to the Phoenix and Crane Pavilions.

sentences.zh: 丁未，師德薨。

translations.literal: Dingwei day: Shide died.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei, Lou Shide died.

sentences.zh: 試天官侍郎陸元方為鸞臺侍郎、同鳳閣鸞臺平章事。

translations.literal: Acting Vice Minister of Heaven Lu Yuanfang became Crane Pavilion Attendant and deliberated jointly on state affairs with the Phoenix and Crane Pavilions.
translations.idiomatic: Lu Yuanfang, acting Vice Minister of Heaven, was named Crane Pavilion Attendant and joined the Phoenix and Crane Pavilions in deliberating jointly on state affairs.

sentences.zh: 戊申，三思為內史。

translations.literal: Wushen day: Sansi became Inner Secretariat [director].
translations.idiomatic: On wushen, Wu Sansi was named director of the Inner Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 九月庚辰，及善薨。

translations.literal: Ninth month, gengchen day: Jishan died.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on gengchen, Wang Jishan died.

sentences.zh: 700 久視元年庚子

translations.literal: 700 CE, first year of the Jiushi reign, gengzi year.
translations.idiomatic: 700 CE, first year of the Jiushi reign, gengzi year.

sentences.zh: 正月戊午，頊貶琰川尉。

translations.literal: First month, wuwu day: Ji was demoted to captain of Yanchuan.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month, on wuwu, Ji Xu was demoted to captain of Yanchuan.

sentences.zh: 壬申，三思罷為特進、太子少保。

translations.literal: Renshen day: Sansi was removed and became specially advanced and Junior Guardian of the Crown Prince.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen, Wu Sansi was relieved and made specially advanced and junior guardian of the crown prince.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，狄仁傑為內史。

translations.literal: Dingyou day: Di Renjie became Inner Secretariat [director].
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou, Di Renjie was named director of the Inner Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 庚子，文昌左相韋巨源為納言。

translations.literal: Gengzi day: Left chief councillor of Wenchang Wei Juyuan became Chief of the Palace Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi, Wei Juyuan, left chief councillor of Wenchang, was named Chief of the Palace Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 二月乙未，欽望罷為太子賓客。

translations.literal: Second month, yiwei day: Qinwang was removed and became crown prince guest.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on yiwei, Dou Lu Qinwang was relieved and appointed crown prince guest.

sentences.zh: 三月癸丑，元忠兼洛州長史。

translations.literal: Third month, guichou day: Yuanzhong additionally [served as] Luozhou chief administrator.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on guichou, Wei Yuanzhong was additionally named chief administrator of Luozhou.

sentences.zh: 辛未，嶠守鸞臺侍郎兼修國史。

translations.literal: Xinwei day: Jiao acted as Crane Pavilion Attendant and compiled the national history.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei, Li Jiao served as acting Crane Pavilion Attendant and compiled the national history.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，頊加左控鶴內供奉。

translations.literal: Jiaxu day: Ji was promoted to left internal attendant of the Controlled Crane Guard.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu, Ji Xu was promoted to left internal attendant of the Controlled Crane Guard.

sentences.zh: 六月丁亥，元忠為左肅政臺御史大夫。

translations.literal: Sixth month, dinghai day: Yuanzhong became Left Attendant Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on dinghai, Wei Yuanzhong was named Left Attendant Censor-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 閏七月己丑，嶠罷為成均祭酒。

translations.literal: Intercalary seventh month, jichou day: Jiao was removed and became director of the Directorate of Education.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary seventh month, on jichou, Li Jiao was relieved and appointed director of the directorate of education.

sentences.zh: 守天官侍郎張錫為鳳閣侍郎、同鳳閣鸞臺平章事。

translations.literal: Acting Vice Minister of Heaven Zhang Xi became Phoenix Pavilion Attendant and deliberated jointly on state affairs with the Phoenix and Crane Pavilions.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Xi, acting Vice Minister of Heaven, was named Phoenix Pavilion Attendant and joined the Phoenix and Crane Pavilions in deliberating jointly on state affairs.

sentences.zh: 八月庚戌，元忠為隴右諸軍州大總管。

translations.literal: Eighth month, gengxu day: Yuanzhong became grand commander of the Longyou armies and prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on gengxu, Wei Yuanzhong was appointed grand commander of the Longyou armies and prefectures.

sentences.zh: 九月辛丑，仁傑薨。

translations.literal: Ninth month, xinchou day: Renjie died.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on xinchou, Di Renjie died.

sentences.zh: 十月辛亥，元忠為蕭關道行軍大總管。

translations.literal: Tenth month, xinhai day: Yuanzhong became grand commander of the Xiaoguan Circuit field army.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, on xinhai, Wei Yuanzhong was appointed grand commander of the Xiaoguan Circuit field army.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，巨源罷為地官尚書。

translations.literal: Dingsi day: Juyuan was removed and became Minister of Earth.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi, Wei Juyuan was relieved and appointed Minister of Earth.

sentences.zh: 文昌右丞韋安石守鸞臺侍郎、同鳳閣鸞臺平章事。

translations.literal: Right director of Wenchang Wei Anshi acted as Crane Pavilion Attendant and deliberated jointly on state affairs with the Phoenix and Crane Pavilions.
translations.idiomatic: Wei Anshi, right director of Wenchang, served as acting Crane Pavilion Attendant and joined the Phoenix and Crane Pavilions in deliberating jointly on state affairs.

sentences.zh: 701 長安元年辛丑

translations.literal: 701 CE, first year of the Chang'an reign, xinchou year.
translations.idiomatic: 701 CE, first year of the Chang'an reign, xinchou year.

sentences.zh: 二月己酉，鸞臺侍郎李懷遠同鳳閣鸞臺平章事。

translations.literal: Second month, jiyou day: Crane Pavilion Attendant Li Huaiyuan deliberated jointly on state affairs with the Phoenix and Crane Pavilions.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on jiyou, Li Huaiyuan, Crane Pavilion Attendant, joined the Phoenix and Crane Pavilions in deliberating jointly on state affairs.

sentences.zh: 三月己卯，元崇為鳳閣侍郎。

translations.literal: Third month, jimao day: Yuanchong became Phoenix Pavilion Attendant.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on jimao, Yao Yuanchong was named Phoenix Pavilion Attendant.

sentences.zh: 丙申，錫流循州。

translations.literal: Bingshen day: Xi was exiled to Xunzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen, Zhang Xi was exiled to Xunzhou.

sentences.zh: 四月癸丑，元崇往并州以北檢校諸軍州兵馬。

translations.literal: Fourth month, guichou day: Yuanchong went north of Bingzhou to inspect military and horse affairs of the armies and prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, on guichou, Yao Yuanchong went north of Bingzhou to inspect military and cavalry affairs of the armies and prefectures.

sentences.zh: 五月丁丑，元忠為靈武道行軍大總管。

translations.literal: Fifth month, dingchou day: Yuanzhong became grand commander of the Lingwu Circuit field army.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on dingchou, Wei Yuanzhong was appointed grand commander of the Lingwu Circuit field army.

sentences.zh: 丙申，天官侍郎顧琮同鳳閣鸞臺平章事。

translations.literal: Bingshen day: Vice Minister of Heaven Gu Cong deliberated jointly on state affairs with the Phoenix and Crane Pavilions.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen, Gu Cong, Vice Minister of Heaven, joined the Phoenix and Crane Pavilions in deliberating jointly on state affairs.

sentences.zh: 六月庚申，元崇兼知夏官尚書事，夏官侍郎。

translations.literal: Sixth month, gengshen day: Yuanchong additionally knew Minister of Summer affairs and [served as] Vice Minister of Summer.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on gengshen, Yao Yuanchong was additionally charged with Minister of Summer affairs and served as Vice Minister of Summer.

sentences.zh: 右奉宸內供奉李迥秀同鳳閣鸞臺平章事。

translations.literal: Right Internal Attendant of the Imperial Guard Li Huijiu deliberated jointly on state affairs with the Phoenix and Crane Pavilions.
translations.idiomatic: Li Huijiu, right internal attendant of the imperial guard, joined the Phoenix and Crane Pavilions in deliberating jointly on state affairs.

sentences.zh: 七月壬午，味道充使往幽、平等州按察兵馬。

translations.literal: Seventh month, renwu day: Weidao served as envoy to You and Ping prefectures to inspect military and horse affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, on renwu, Su Weidao was sent as envoy to You and Ping prefectures to inspect military and cavalry affairs.

sentences.zh: 甲申，懷遠罷為秋官尚書。

translations.literal: Jiashen day: Huaiyuan was removed and became Minister of Autumn.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen, Li Huaiyuan was relieved and appointed Minister of Autumn.

sentences.zh: 十月丙寅，元忠同鳳閣鸞臺三品，兼群牧大使。

translations.literal: Tenth month, bingyin day: Yuanzhong received rank equal to the Phoenix and Crane Pavilions and additionally [served as] commissioner of the imperial stud.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, on bingyin, Wei Yuanzhong was given rank equal to the Phoenix and Crane Pavilions and additionally named commissioner of the imperial stud.

sentences.zh: 十一月壬申，三思罷為特進、太子少保。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, renshen day: Sansi was removed and became specially advanced and Junior Guardian of the Crown Prince.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on renshen, Wu Sansi was relieved and made specially advanced and junior guardian of the crown prince.

sentences.zh: 甲午，元崇加相王府長史，安石加檢校太子左庶子。

translations.literal: Jiawu day: Yuanchong was promoted to chief administrator of the Prince of Xiang's household; Anshi was promoted to acting supervisor of crown prince left senior support.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu, Yao Yuanchong was promoted to chief administrator of the Prince of Xiang's household; Wei Anshi was promoted to acting supervisor of the crown prince left senior support.

sentences.zh: 702 二年壬寅

translations.literal: 702 CE, second year, renyin year.
translations.idiomatic: 702 CE, second year, renyin year.

sentences.zh: 三月丙戌，迥秀充使山東諸州安置軍馬并檢校武騎兵。

translations.literal: Third month, bingxu day: Huijiu served as envoy to the eastern Shandong prefectures to settle military horses and inspect martial cavalry.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on bingxu, Li Huijiu was sent as envoy to the eastern Shandong prefectures to settle military horses and inspect martial cavalry.

sentences.zh: 五月，元忠為安北道行軍副元帥，尋授并州道行軍大總管兼宣勞使、左肅政臺御史大夫、同鳳閣鸞臺三品，兼知并州事。

translations.literal: Fifth month: Yuanzhong became deputy field commander of the Anbei Circuit; soon [he] was appointed grand commander of the Bingzhou Circuit field army and concurrent commissioner to proclaim imperial favor, Left Attendant Censor-in-Chief, with rank equal to the Phoenix and Crane Pavilions, additionally knowing Bingzhou affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, Wei Yuanzhong was named deputy field commander of the Anbei Circuit; soon he was appointed grand commander of the Bingzhou Circuit field army and concurrent commissioner to proclaim imperial favor, Left Attendant Censor-in-Chief, with rank equal to the Phoenix and Crane Pavilions, additionally in charge of Bingzhou affairs.

sentences.zh: 十月甲辰，琮薨。

translations.literal: Tenth month, jiachen day: Cong died.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, on jiachen, Gu Cong died.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，元崇同鳳閣鸞臺平章事，味道、迥秀、安石並同鳳閣鸞臺三品。

translations.literal: Jiayin day: Yuanchong deliberated jointly on state affairs with the Phoenix and Crane Pavilions; Weidao, Huijiu, and Anshi all received rank equal to the Phoenix and Crane Pavilions.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin, Yao Yuanchong joined the Phoenix and Crane Pavilions in deliberating jointly on state affairs; Su Weidao, Li Huijiu, and Wei Anshi were all given rank equal to the Phoenix and Crane Pavilions.

sentences.zh: 十二月甲午，元忠為安東道安撫使。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, jiawu day: Yuanzhong became pacification commissioner of the Andong Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on jiawu, Wei Yuanzhong was named pacification commissioner of the Andong Circuit.

sentences.zh: 十一月甲子，相王旦為司徒。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, jiazi day: Prince of Xiang Dan became Minister of Education.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on jiazi, Prince of Xiang Li Dan was named Minister of Education.

sentences.zh: 閏四月庚午，嶠兼左丞、同鳳閣鸞臺平章事。

translations.literal: Intercalary fourth month, gengwu day: Jiao additionally [served as] left director and deliberated jointly on state affairs with the Phoenix and Crane Pavilions.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary fourth month, on gengwu, Li Jiao was additionally named left director and joined the Phoenix and Crane Pavilions in deliberating jointly on state affairs.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，安石為神都留守，判天官、秋官二尚書事。

translations.literal: Dingchou day: Anshi became capital guardian of Shendu, adjudicating the Ministries of Heaven and Autumn.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou, Wei Anshi was named capital guardian of Shendu with adjudication of the Ministries of Heaven and Autumn.

sentences.zh: 己卯，嶠知納言事。

translations.literal: Jimao day: Jiao knew Palace Secretariat affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao, Li Jiao was charged with Palace Secretariat affairs.

sentences.zh: 五月戊戌，元忠兼左庶子。

translations.literal: Fifth month, wuxu day: Yuanzhong additionally [served as] left senior support.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on wuxu, Wei Yuanzhong was additionally named left senior support.

sentences.zh: 七月壬寅，正諫大夫朱敬則同鳳閣鸞臺平章事。

translations.literal: Seventh month, renyin day: Grand Remonstrance Master Zhu Jingze deliberated jointly on state affairs with the Phoenix and Crane Pavilions.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, on renyin, Zhu Jingze, grand remonstrance master, joined the Phoenix and Crane Pavilions in deliberating jointly on state affairs.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，檢校涼州都督唐休璟為夏官尚書、同鳳閣鸞臺平章事。

translations.literal: Gengxu day: Acting Liangzhou area commander Tang Xiujing became Minister of Summer and deliberated jointly on state affairs with the Phoenix and Crane Pavilions.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu, Tang Xiujing, acting Liangzhou area commander, was named Minister of Summer and joined the Phoenix and Crane Pavilions in deliberating jointly on state affairs.

sentences.zh: 九月丁酉，元忠貶高要尉。

translations.literal: Ninth month, dingyou day: Yuanzhong was demoted to captain of Gaoyao.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on dingyou, Wei Yuanzhong was demoted to captain of Gaoyao.

sentences.zh: 四月庚子，相王旦罷。

translations.literal: Fourth month, gengzi day: Prince of Xiang Dan was removed.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, on gengzi, Prince of Xiang Li Dan was dismissed.

sentences.zh: 正月壬子，天官侍郎韋嗣立為鳳閣侍郎、同鳳閣鸞臺三品。

translations.literal: First month, renzi day: Vice Minister of Heaven Wei Sili became Phoenix Pavilion Attendant with rank equal to the Phoenix and Crane Pavilions.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month, on renzi, Wei Sili, Vice Minister of Heaven, was named Phoenix Pavilion Attendant with rank equal to the Phoenix and Crane Pavilions.

sentences.zh: 二月癸亥，迥秀貶廬州刺史。

translations.literal: Second month, guihai day: Huijiu was demoted to prefect of Lu.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on guihai, Li Huijiu was demoted to prefect of Lu.

sentences.zh: 壬申，敬則致仕。

translations.literal: Renshen day: Jingze retired.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen, Zhu Jingze retired from office.

sentences.zh: 三月己丑，嗣立檢校汴州刺史。

translations.literal: Third month, jichou day: Sili inspected the Bianzhou chief administrator.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on jichou, Wei Sili was made acting supervisor of the Bianzhou chief administrator.

sentences.zh: 己亥，貶味道坊州刺史。

translations.literal: Jihai day: Weidao was demoted to prefect of Fang.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai, Su Weidao was demoted to prefect of Fang.

sentences.zh: 夏官侍郎宗楚客同鳳閣鸞臺平章事，休璟行右庶子。

translations.literal: Vice Minister of Summer Zong Chuke deliberated jointly on state affairs with the Phoenix and Crane Pavilions; Xiujing acted as right senior support.
translations.idiomatic: Zong Chuke, Vice Minister of Summer, joined the Phoenix and Crane Pavilions in deliberating jointly on state affairs; Tang Xiujing served as acting right senior support.

sentences.zh: 四月壬戌，安石知納言事，嶠知內史事。

translations.literal: Fourth month, renxu day: Anshi knew Palace Secretariat affairs; Jiao knew Inner Secretariat affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, on renxu, Wei Anshi was charged with Palace Secretariat affairs and Li Jiao with Inner Secretariat affairs.

sentences.zh: 六月辛酉，元崇罷為相王府長史，一事以上並同三品。

translations.literal: Sixth month, xinyou day: Yuanchong was removed and became chief administrator of the Prince of Xiang's household; all matters above one level [received rank] equal to the Three Departments.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on xinyou, Yao Yuanchong was relieved and appointed chief administrator of the Prince of Xiang's household, with all matters above one level given rank equal to the Three Departments.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，天官侍郎崔玄暐為鸞臺侍郎、同鳳閣鸞臺平章事。

translations.literal: Yichou day: Vice Minister of Heaven Cui Xuanwei became Crane Pavilion Attendant and deliberated jointly on state affairs with the Phoenix and Crane Pavilions.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou, Cui Xuanwei, Vice Minister of Heaven, was named Crane Pavilion Attendant and joined the Phoenix and Crane Pavilions in deliberating jointly on state affairs.

sentences.zh: 嗣立追赴宮所。

translations.literal: Sili was recalled to the palace precincts.
translations.idiomatic: Wei Sili was recalled to the palace precincts.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，嶠為成均祭酒、同鳳閣鸞臺三品。

translations.literal: Dingchou day: Jiao became director of the Directorate of Education with rank equal to the Phoenix and Crane Pavilions.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou, Li Jiao was named director of the directorate of education with rank equal to the Phoenix and Crane Pavilions.

sentences.zh: 壬午，元崇兼知夏官尚書、同鳳閣鸞臺三品。

translations.literal: Renwu day: Yuanchong additionally knew Minister of Summer affairs with rank equal to the Phoenix and Crane Pavilions.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu, Yao Yuanchong was additionally charged with Minister of Summer affairs with rank equal to the Phoenix and Crane Pavilions.

sentences.zh: 七月丙戌，左肅政臺御史大夫楊再思守內史。

translations.literal: Seventh month, bingxu day: Left Attendant Censor-in-Chief Yang Zaisi acted as Inner Secretariat [director].
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, on bingxu, Yang Zaisi, Left Attendant Censor-in-Chief, served as acting director of the Inner Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 甲午，楚客貶原州都督。

translations.literal: Jiawu day: Chuke was demoted to area commander of Yuanzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu, Zong Chuke was demoted to area commander of Yuanzhou.

sentences.zh: 八月甲寅，安石兼檢校揚州長史。

translations.literal: Eighth month, jiayin day: Anshi additionally inspected the Yangzhou chief administrator.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on jiayin, Wei Anshi was additionally made acting supervisor of the Yangzhou chief administrator.

sentences.zh: 庚申，休璟兼幽營二州都督、安東都護。

translations.literal: Gengshen day: Xiujing additionally [served as] area commander of You and Ying prefectures and Protector-general of Andong.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen, Tang Xiujing was additionally named area commander of You and Ying prefectures and Protector-general of Andong.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，元崇兼知春官尚書。

translations.literal: Xinyou day: Yuanchong additionally knew Minister of Spring affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou, Yao Yuanchong was additionally charged with Minister of Spring affairs.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，元崇為司僕卿。

translations.literal: Gengchen day: Yuanchong became Director of the Court of the Imperial Stud.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen, Yao Yuanchong was named director of the Court of the Imperial Stud.

sentences.zh: 九月壬子，元之知群牧使，兼攝右肅政臺御史大夫、靈武道行軍大總管。

translations.literal: Ninth month, renzi day: Yuanzhi knew the imperial stud commissioner and additionally acted as Right Attendant Censor-in-Chief and grand commander of the Lingwu Circuit field army.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on renzi, Zhang Yuanzhi was charged with the imperial stud commission and additionally served as Right Attendant Censor-in-Chief and grand commander of the Lingwu Circuit field army.

sentences.zh: 十月辛酉，元之為靈武道安撫大使，權檢校左臺大夫。

translations.literal: Tenth month, xinyou day: Yuanzhi became Lingwu Circuit pacification commissioner and provisionally inspected the Left Terrace director.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, on xinyou, Zhang Yuanzhi was named Lingwu Circuit pacification commissioner and provisionally made acting supervisor of the Left Terrace director.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，判秋官侍郎張柬之同鳳閣鸞臺平章事。

translations.literal: Jiaxu day: Acting Vice Minister of Autumn Zhang Jianzhi deliberated jointly on state affairs with the Phoenix and Crane Pavilions.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu, Zhang Jianzhi, acting Vice Minister of Autumn, joined the Phoenix and Crane Pavilions in deliberating jointly on state affairs.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，嗣立檢校魏州刺史。

translations.literal: Yihai day: Sili inspected the Weizhou chief administrator.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai, Wei Sili was made acting supervisor of the Weizhou chief administrator.

sentences.zh: 壬午，懷州長史房融為正諫大夫、同鳳閣鸞臺平章事。

translations.literal: Renwu day: Huaizhou Chief Administrator Fang Rong became Grand Remonstrance Master and deliberated jointly on state affairs with the Phoenix and Crane Pavilions.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu, Fang Rong, chief administrator of Huaizhou, was named grand remonstrance master and joined the Phoenix and Crane Pavilions in deliberating jointly on state affairs.

sentences.zh: 十一月丁亥，天官侍郎韋承慶行鳳閣侍郎、同鳳閣鸞臺平章事，柬之守鳳閣侍郎。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, dinghai day: Vice Minister of Heaven Wei Chengqing acted as Phoenix Pavilion Attendant and deliberated jointly on state affairs with the Phoenix and Crane Pavilions; Jianzhi acted as Phoenix Pavilion Attendant.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on dinghai, Wei Chengqing, Vice Minister of Heaven, served as acting Phoenix Pavilion Attendant and joined the Phoenix and Crane Pavilions in deliberating jointly on state affairs; Zhang Jianzhi served as acting Phoenix Pavilion Attendant.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，嶠罷為地官尚書，監修國史。

translations.literal: Guimao day: Jiao was removed and became Minister of Earth, compiling the national history.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao, Li Jiao was relieved and appointed Minister of Earth to compile the national history.

sentences.zh: 丁未，玄暐兼檢校太子右庶子。

translations.literal: Dingwei day: Xuanwei additionally inspected crown prince right senior support.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei, Cui Xuanwei was additionally made acting supervisor of the crown prince right senior support.

sentences.zh: 十二月丙辰，嗣立罷為成均祭酒。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, bingchen day: Sili was removed and became director of the Directorate of Education.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on bingchen, Wei Sili was relieved and appointed director of the directorate of education.

sentences.zh: 705 神龍元年乙巳

translations.literal: 705 CE, first year of the Shenlong reign, yisi year.
translations.idiomatic: 705 CE, first year of the Shenlong reign, yisi year.

sentences.zh: 正月甲辰，司刑少卿袁恕己為鳳閣侍郎、同鳳閣鸞臺平章事。

translations.literal: First month, jiachen day: Vice Director of Punishments Yuan Shuji became Phoenix Pavilion Attendant and deliberated jointly on state affairs with the Phoenix and Crane Pavilions.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month, on jiachen, Yuan Shuji, vice director of punishments, was named Phoenix Pavilion Attendant and joined the Phoenix and Crane Pavilions in deliberating jointly on state affairs.

sentences.zh: 丙午，安國相王為太尉、同鳳閣鸞臺三品。

translations.literal: Bingwu day: Prince of An Guo became Grand Marshal with rank equal to the Phoenix and Crane Pavilions.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu, Prince of An Guo was named Grand Marshal with rank equal to the Phoenix and Crane Pavilions.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，玄暐守內史。

translations.literal: Gengxu day: Xuanwei acted as Inner Secretariat [director].
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu, Cui Xuanwei served as acting director of the Inner Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 左羽林將軍敬暉、檢校左羽林將軍桓彥範並為納言。

translations.literal: Left Feathered Forest General Jing Hui and acting Left Feathered Forest General Huan Yanfan both became Chief of the Palace Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: Jing Hui, general of the Left Feathered Forest, and Huan Yanfan, acting general of the Left Feathered Forest, were both named Chief of the Palace Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 柬之為天官尚書，恕己為鳳閣侍郎，並同鳳閣鸞臺三品。

translations.literal: Jianzhi became Minister of Heaven; Shuji became Phoenix Pavilion Attendant; both with rank equal to the Phoenix and Crane Pavilions.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Jianzhi was named Minister of Heaven and Yuan Shuji Phoenix Pavilion Attendant; both with rank equal to the Phoenix and Crane Pavilions.

sentences.zh: 二月甲寅，再思為戶部尚書、同中書門下三品。

translations.literal: Second month, jiayin day: Zaisi became Minister of Revenue with rank equal to the Three Departments.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on jiayin, Yang Zaisi was named Minister of Revenue with rank equal to the Three Departments.

sentences.zh: 元之罷為豪州刺史，韋承慶貶高要尉，融除名，流高州。

translations.literal: Yuanzhi was removed and became prefect of Hao; Wei Chengqing demoted to captain of Gaoyao; Rong stripped of name and exiled to Gaozhou.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Yuanzhi was relieved and appointed prefect of Hao; Wei Chengqing was demoted to captain of Gaoyao; Fang Rong was dismissed, expunged from the rolls, and exiled to Gaozhou.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，太子少詹事祝欽明同中書門下三品，安石罷為守刑部尚書。

translations.literal: Jiaxu day: Crown Prince Junior Household Administrator Zhu Qinming received rank equal to the Three Departments; Anshi was removed and became acting Minister of Justice.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu, Zhu Qinming, crown prince junior household administrator, was given rank equal to the Three Departments; Wei Anshi was relieved and appointed acting Minister of Justice.

sentences.zh: 三月己丑，恕己守中書令。

translations.literal: Third month, jichou day: Shuji acted as Director of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on jichou, Yuan Shuji served as acting Director of the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 四月辛亥，恕己為中書令，彥範為侍中，柬之為天官尚書。

translations.literal: Fourth month, xinhai day: Shuji became Director of the Secretariat; Yanfan Palace Secretariat Attendant; Jianzhi Minister of Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, on xinhai, Yuan Shuji was named Director of the Secretariat; Huan Yanfan Palace Secretariat Attendant; Zhang Jianzhi Minister of Heaven.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，元忠為衛尉卿、同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: Dingmao day: Yuanzhong became Court Commandant and deliberated jointly on state affairs with the Secretariat and Palace Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao, Wei Yuanzhong was named court commandant and joined the Secretariat and Palace Secretariat in deliberating jointly on state affairs.

sentences.zh: 辛未，暉為侍中。

translations.literal: Xinwei day: Hui became Palace Secretariat Attendant.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei, Jing Hui was appointed Palace Secretariat Attendant.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，元忠為兵部尚書，安石為吏部尚書，懷遠為左散騎常侍，休璟自涼州入為輔國大將軍，並同中書門下三品。

translations.literal: Jiaxu day: Yuanzhong became Minister of War; Anshi Minister of Personnel; Huaiyuan Left Regular Attendant; Xiujing entered from Liangzhou as Assistant State-supporting Grand General; all with rank equal to the Three Departments.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu, Wei Yuanzhong was named Minister of War; Wei Anshi Minister of Personnel; Li Huaiyuan Left Regular Attendant; Tang Xiujing, arriving from Liangzhou, Assistant State-supporting Grand General; all with rank equal to the Three Departments.

sentences.zh: 再思檢校揚州大都督。

translations.literal: Zaisi inspected the Yangzhou area command.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Zaisi was made acting supervisor of the Yangzhou area command.

sentences.zh: 玄暐為特進，檢校益州大都督府長史、同中書門下三品。

translations.literal: Xuanwei became specially advanced and inspected the chief administrator of the Yizhou area command with rank equal to the Three Departments.
translations.idiomatic: Cui Xuanwei was made specially advanced and acting supervisor of the chief administrator of the Yizhou area command with rank equal to the Three Departments.

sentences.zh: 欽明守刑部尚書。

translations.literal: Qinming acted as Minister of Justice.
translations.idiomatic: Zhu Qinming served as acting Minister of Justice.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，柬之為中書令、同中書門下三品。

translations.literal: Yihai day: Jianzhi became Director of the Secretariat with rank equal to the Three Departments.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai, Zhang Jianzhi was named Director of the Secretariat with rank equal to the Three Departments.

sentences.zh: 五月甲午，安石兼檢校中書令。

translations.literal: Fifth month, jiawu day: Anshi additionally inspected the Director of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on jiawu, Wei Anshi was additionally made acting supervisor of the Director of the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 玄暐罷為博陵郡王，柬之罷為漢陽郡王，恕己罷為南陽郡王，暉罷為平陽郡王，彥範罷為扶陽郡王，元忠兼侍中。

translations.literal: Xuanwei was removed and became Prince of Boling; Jianzhi Prince of Hanyang; Shuji Prince of Nanyang; Hui Prince of Pingyang; Yanfan Prince of Fuyang; Yuanzhong additionally Palace Secretariat Attendant.
translations.idiomatic: Cui Xuanwei was relieved and enfeoffed as Prince of Boling; Zhang Jianzhi as Prince of Hanyang; Yuan Shuji as Prince of Nanyang; Jing Hui as Prince of Pingyang; Huan Yanfan as Prince of Fuyang; Wei Yuanzhong was additionally named Palace Secretariat Attendant.

sentences.zh: 庚子，懷遠為左散騎常侍。

translations.literal: Gengzi day: Huaiyuan became Left Regular Attendant.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi, Li Huaiyuan was named Left Regular Attendant.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，休璟為尚書左僕射，欽望自特進為右僕射、同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: Jiachen day: Xiujing became Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs; Qinwang from specially advanced became Right Vice Director and deliberated jointly on state affairs with the Secretariat and Palace Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen, Tang Xiujing was appointed Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs; Dou Lu Qinwang, from specially advanced, Right Vice Director, deliberating jointly on state affairs with the Secretariat and Palace Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 六月癸亥，欽望軍國重事中書門下平章，安石為中書令，元忠為侍中，再思檢校中書令。

translations.literal: Sixth month, guihai day: Qinwang deliberated jointly on military and state affairs with the Secretariat and Palace Secretariat; Anshi became Director of the Secretariat; Yuanzhong Palace Secretariat Attendant; Zaisi acted as Director of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on guihai, Dou Lu Qinwang joined the Secretariat and Palace Secretariat in deliberating jointly on military and state affairs; Wei Anshi was named Director of the Secretariat; Wei Yuanzhong Palace Secretariat Attendant; and Yang Zaisi served as acting Director of the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 七月辛巳，太子賓客韋巨源同中書門下三品。

translations.literal: Seventh month, xinsi day: Crown Prince Guest Wei Juyuan received rank equal to the Three Departments.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, on xinsi, Wei Juyuan, crown prince guest, was given rank equal to the Three Departments.

sentences.zh: 八月，欽望兼檢校安國相王府長史。

translations.literal: Eighth month: Qinwang additionally inspected chief administrator of the Prince of An Guo's household.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, Dou Lu Qinwang was additionally made acting supervisor of the chief administrator of the Prince of An Guo's household.

sentences.zh: 九月癸巳，巨源罷為禮部尚書。

translations.literal: Ninth month, guisi day: Juyuan was removed and became Minister of Rites.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on guisi, Wei Juyuan was relieved and appointed Minister of Rites.

sentences.zh: 十月丁未，休璟為京留守，仍判尚書省事。

translations.literal: Tenth month, dingwei day: Xiujing became capital guardian of Jing, still adjudicating Department of State Affairs affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, on dingwei, Tang Xiujing was named capital guardian of Jing, still adjudicating Department of State Affairs affairs.

sentences.zh: 辛未，元忠為中書令，再思行侍中。

translations.literal: Xinwei day: Yuanzhong became Director of the Secretariat; Zaisi acted as Palace Secretariat Attendant.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei, Wei Yuanzhong was named Director of the Secretariat; Yang Zaisi served as acting Palace Secretariat Attendant.

sentences.zh: 正月丙午，安國相王為太尉。

translations.literal: First month, bingwu day: Prince of An Guo became Grand Marshal.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month, on bingwu, Prince of An Guo was named Grand Marshal.

sentences.zh: 二月丙寅，梁王武三思為司空、同中書門下三品。

translations.literal: Second month, bingyin day: Prince of Liang Wu Sansi became Minister of Works with rank equal to the Three Departments.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on bingyin, Prince of Liang Wu Sansi was named Minister of Works with rank equal to the Three Departments.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，右散騎常侍武攸暨為司徒。

translations.literal: Dingmao day: Right Regular Attendant Wu Youji became Minister of Education.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao, Wu Youji, Right Regular Attendant, was named Minister of Education.

sentences.zh: 辛未，安國相王讓太尉、同三品。

translations.literal: Xinwei day: Prince of An Guo yielded the Grand Marshalship and received rank equal to the Three Departments.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei, Prince of An Guo relinquished the grand marshalship and received rank equal to the Three Departments.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，三思、攸暨罷。

translations.literal: Dingchou day: Sansi and Youji were removed.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou, Wu Sansi and Wu Youji were dismissed.

sentences.zh: 正月戊戌，守吏部尚書李嶠同中書門下三品，中書侍郎于惟謙同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: First month, wuxu day: Acting Minister of Personnel Li Jiao received rank equal to the Three Departments; Secretariat Attendant Yu Weiqian deliberated jointly on state affairs with the Secretariat and Palace Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month, on wuxu, Li Jiao, acting Minister of Personnel, was given rank equal to the Three Departments; Yu Weiqian, Secretariat Attendant, joined the Secretariat and Palace Secretariat in deliberating jointly on state affairs.

sentences.zh: 二月乙未，禮部尚書韋巨源守刑部尚書、同中書門下三品。

translations.literal: Second month, yiwei day: Minister of Rites Wei Juyuan acted as Minister of Justice with rank equal to the Three Departments.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on yiwei, Wei Juyuan, Minister of Rites, served as acting Minister of Justice with rank equal to the Three Departments.

sentences.zh: 三月甲辰，安石罷為戶部尚書。

translations.literal: Third month, jiachen day: Anshi was removed and became Minister of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on jiachen, Wei Anshi was relieved and appointed Minister of Revenue.

sentences.zh: 戶部尚書蘇瑰守侍中。

translations.literal: Minister of Revenue Su Gui acted as Palace Secretariat Attendant.
translations.idiomatic: Su Gui, Minister of Revenue, served as acting Palace Secretariat Attendant.

sentences.zh: 戊申，休璟致仕。

translations.literal: Wushen day: Xiujing retired.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen, Tang Xiujing retired from office.

sentences.zh: 四月己丑，懷遠致仕。

translations.literal: Fourth month, jichou day: Huaiyuan retired.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, on jichou, Li Huaiyuan retired from office.

sentences.zh: 六月戊寅，貶暉為崖州司馬，彥範瀧州司馬，恕己竇州司馬，玄暐白州司馬，柬之新州司馬。

translations.literal: Sixth month, wuyin day: Hui demoted to marshal of Yazhou; Yanfan to marshal of Longzhou; Shuji to marshal of Douzhou; Xuanwei to marshal of Baizhou; Jianzhi to marshal of Xinzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on wuyin, Jing Hui was demoted to marshal of Yazhou; Huan Yanfan to Longzhou; Yuan Shuji to Douzhou; Cui Xuanwei to Baizhou; and Zhang Jianzhi to Xinzhou.

sentences.zh: 七月丙寅，元忠為尚書右僕射、兼中書令，仍知兵部事。

translations.literal: Seventh month, bingyin day: Yuanzhong became Right Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs and concurrent Director of the Secretariat, still knowing Ministry of War affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, on bingyin, Wei Yuanzhong was appointed Right Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs and concurrent Director of the Secretariat, still in charge of Ministry of War affairs.

sentences.zh: 嶠守中書令。

translations.literal: Jiao acted as Director of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: Li Jiao served as acting Director of the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 辛未，懷遠復為同中書門下三品。

translations.literal: Xinwei day: Huaiyuan again received rank equal to the Three Departments.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei, Li Huaiyuan again received rank equal to the Three Departments.

sentences.zh: 流暉于嘉州，彥範于瀼州，恕己于環州，玄暐于古州，柬之于瀧州。

translations.literal: Exiled Hui to Jiazhou, Yanfan to Rangzhou, Shuji to Huanzhou, Xuanwei to Guzhou, Jianzhi to Longzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Jing Hui was exiled to Jiazhou, Huan Yanfan to Rangzhou, Yuan Shuji to Huanzhou, Cui Xuanwei to Guzhou, and Zhang Jianzhi to Longzhou.

sentences.zh: 八月丙子，欽明貶申州刺史。

translations.literal: Eighth month, bingzi day: Qinming was demoted to prefect of Shen.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on bingzi, Zhu Qinming was demoted to prefect of Shen.

sentences.zh: 九月戊午，懷遠薨。

translations.literal: Ninth month, wuwu day: Huaiyuan died.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on wuwu, Li Huaiyuan died.

sentences.zh: 十月癸巳，瑰為侍中。

translations.literal: Tenth month, guisi day: Gui became Palace Secretariat Attendant.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, on guisi, Su Gui was named Palace Secretariat Attendant.

sentences.zh: 十二月丙申，欽望為開府儀同三司，依舊平章軍國重事。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, bingshen day: Qinwang became Honored Companion of the First Rank, still deliberating jointly on military and state affairs as before.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on bingshen, Dou Lu Qinwang was named honored companion of the first rank, still charged to deliberate jointly on military and state affairs as before.

sentences.zh: 元忠為尚書左僕射。

translations.literal: Yuanzhong became Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Wei Yuanzhong was appointed Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs.

sentences.zh: 707 景龍元年丁未

translations.literal: 707 CE, first year of the Jinglong reign, dingwei year.
translations.idiomatic: 707 CE, first year of the Jinglong reign, dingwei year.

sentences.zh: 七月壬戌，嶠為中書令，巨源為吏部尚書，元忠加特進。

translations.literal: Seventh month, renxu day: Jiao became Director of the Secretariat; Juyuan Minister of Personnel; Yuanzhong was promoted to specially advanced.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, on renxu, Li Jiao was named Director of the Secretariat; Wei Juyuan Minister of Personnel; and Wei Yuanzhong was promoted to specially advanced.

sentences.zh: 八月丙戌，元忠以特進致仕。

translations.literal: Eighth month, bingxu day: Yuanzhong retired as specially advanced.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on bingxu, Wei Yuanzhong retired with the rank of specially advanced.

sentences.zh: 九月丁酉，惟謙罷為國子祭酒。

translations.literal: Ninth month, dingyou day: Weiqian was removed and became director of the Directorate of Education.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on dingyou, Yu Weiqian was relieved and appointed director of the directorate of education.

sentences.zh: 行兵部尚書宗楚客左衛將軍，兼太府卿紀處訥為太僕卿，吏部侍郎蕭至忠為黃門侍郎，並同中書門下三品。

translations.literal: Acting Minister of War Zong Chuke Left Guard General, concurrently Court of the Imperial Stud Director Ji Chune Grand Herald, Vice Minister of Personnel Xiao Zhizhong Yellow Gate Attendant; all with rank equal to the Three Departments.
translations.idiomatic: Zong Chuke, acting Minister of War, was named general of the Left Guard; Ji Chune, court of the imperial stud director, grand herald; Xiao Zhizhong, Vice Minister of Personnel, Yellow Gate Attendant; all with rank equal to the Three Departments.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，至忠行中書侍郎。

translations.literal: Bingchen day: Zhizhong acted as Secretariat Attendant.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen, Xiao Zhizhong served as acting Secretariat Attendant.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，再思為中書令，巨源、處訥為侍中。

translations.literal: Xinhai day: Zaisi became Director of the Secretariat; Juyuan and Chune Palace Secretariat Attendants.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai, Yang Zaisi was named Director of the Secretariat; Wei Juyuan and Ji Chune Palace Secretariat Attendants.

sentences.zh: 瑰罷為行吏部尚書。

translations.literal: Gui was removed and became acting Minister of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: Su Gui was relieved and appointed acting Minister of Personnel.

sentences.zh: 708 二年戊申

translations.literal: 708 CE, second year, wushen year.
translations.idiomatic: 708 CE, second year, wushen year.

sentences.zh: 七月癸巳，左屯衛大將軍、朔方道行軍大總管張仁亶同中書門下三品。

translations.literal: Seventh month, guisi day: Left Encampment Guard General and Shuofang Circuit field army grand commander Zhang Renbian received rank equal to the Three Departments.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, on guisi, Zhang Renbian, general of the Left Encampment Guard and grand commander of the Shuofang Circuit field army, was given rank equal to the Three Departments.

sentences.zh: 709 三年己酉

translations.literal: 709 CE, third year, jiyou year.
translations.idiomatic: 709 CE, third year, jiyou year.

sentences.zh: 二月壬寅，巨源為尚書左僕射，再思為右僕射，同中書門下三品。

translations.literal: Second month, renyin day: Juyuan became Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs; Zaisi Right Vice Director; both with rank equal to the Three Departments.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on renyin, Wei Juyuan was appointed Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs and Yang Zaisi Right Vice Director; both with rank equal to the Three Departments.

sentences.zh: 三月戊午，楚客為中書令，至忠守侍中，太府卿韋嗣立守兵部尚書、同中書門下三品。

translations.literal: Third month, wuwu day: Chuke became Director of the Secretariat; Zhizhong acted as Palace Secretariat Attendant; Court of the Imperial Stud Director Wei Sili acted as Minister of War with rank equal to the Three Departments.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on wuwu, Zong Chuke was named Director of the Secretariat; Xiao Zhizhong served as acting Palace Secretariat Attendant; and Wei Sili, court of the imperial stud director, served as acting Minister of War with rank equal to the Three Departments.

sentences.zh: 中書侍郎兼檢校吏部侍郎崔湜，守兵部侍郎趙彥昭為中書侍郎，並同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: Secretariat Attendant and acting Vice Minister of Personnel Cui Shi, acting Vice Minister of War Zhao Yanzhao Secretariat Attendant; both deliberated jointly on state affairs with the Secretariat and Palace Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: Cui Shi, Secretariat Attendant and acting Vice Minister of Personnel, and Zhao Yanzhao, acting Vice Minister of War and Secretariat Attendant, both joined the Secretariat and Palace Secretariat in deliberating jointly on state affairs.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，禮部尚書韋溫為太子少保、同中書門下三品，太常少卿鄭愔守吏部侍郎、同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: Wuyin day: Minister of Rites Wei Wen became Junior Guardian of the Crown Prince with rank equal to the Three Departments; Court of Imperial Sacrifices Vice Director Zheng Yin acted as Vice Minister of Personnel and deliberated jointly on state affairs with the Secretariat and Palace Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin, Wei Wen, Minister of Rites, was named junior guardian of the crown prince with rank equal to the Three Departments; Zheng Yin, court of imperial sacrifices vice director, served as acting Vice Minister of Personnel and joined the Secretariat and Palace Secretariat in deliberating jointly on state affairs.

sentences.zh: 五月丙戌，湜貶襄州刺史，愔貶江州司馬。

translations.literal: Fifth month, bingxu day: Shi demoted to prefect of Xiang; Yin demoted to marshal of Jiangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on bingxu, Cui Shi was demoted to prefect of Xiang and Zheng Yin to marshal of Jiangzhou.

sentences.zh: 六月癸卯，再思薨。

translations.literal: Sixth month, guimao day: Zaisi died.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on guimao, Yang Zaisi died.

sentences.zh: 八月乙酉，嶠守兵部尚書、同中書門下三品，安石自特進為侍中，至忠為中書令。

translations.literal: Eighth month, yiyou day: Jiao acted as Minister of War with rank equal to the Three Departments; Anshi from specially advanced became Palace Secretariat Attendant; Zhizhong Director of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on yiyou, Li Jiao served as acting Minister of War with rank equal to the Three Departments; Wei Anshi, from specially advanced, was named Palace Secretariat Attendant; and Xiao Zhizhong Director of the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 九月，巨源為都留守。

translations.literal: Ninth month: Juyuan became capital guardian.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, Wei Juyuan was named capital guardian.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，瑰為右僕射、同中書門下三品。

translations.literal: Wuchen day: Gui became Right Vice Director with rank equal to the Three Departments.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen, Su Gui was appointed Right Vice Director with rank equal to the Three Departments.

sentences.zh: 十一月甲戌，欽望薨。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, jiaxu day: Qinwang died.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on jiaxu, Dou Lu Qinwang died.

sentences.zh: 十二月壬辰，前右僕射、同三品、宋國公致仕唐休璟為太子少師、同中書門下三品。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, renchen day: Former Right Vice Director with rank equal to the Three Departments, retired Duke of Song Tang Xiujing became Junior Mentor of the Crown Prince with rank equal to the Three Departments.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on renchen, Tang Xiujing, former right vice director with rank equal to the Three Departments and retired Duke of Song, was named junior mentor of the crown prince with rank equal to the Three Departments.

sentences.zh: 710 景雲元年庚戌

translations.literal: 710 CE, first year of the Jingyun reign, gengxu year.
translations.idiomatic: 710 CE, first year of the Jingyun reign, gengxu year.

sentences.zh: 六月壬午，工部尚書張錫、刑部尚書裴談並同中書門下三品，吏部侍郎崔湜、中書侍郎岑羲、吏部尚書張嘉福並同中書門下平章事，溫總知內外兵馬。

translations.literal: Sixth month, renwu day: Minister of Works Zhang Xi and Minister of Justice Pei Tan both received rank equal to the Three Departments; Vice Minister of Personnel Cui Shi, Secretariat Attendant Cen Xi, and Minister of Personnel Zhang Jiafu deliberated jointly on state affairs with the Secretariat and Palace Secretariat; Wen overall supervisor of internal and external military and horse affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on renwu, Zhang Xi, Minister of Works, and Pei Tan, Minister of Justice, both received rank equal to the Three Departments; Cui Shi, Vice Minister of Personnel, Cen Xi, Secretariat Attendant, and Zhang Jiafu, Minister of Personnel, joined the Secretariat and Palace Secretariat in deliberating jointly on state affairs; Wei Wen overall supervisor of internal and external military and cavalry affairs.

sentences.zh: 甲申，相王參謀政事。

translations.literal: Jiashen day: Prince of Xiang deliberated on governmental affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen, Prince of Xiang joined deliberations on governmental affairs.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，嘉福持節河北道巡撫，羲持節河南道巡撫，處訥持節關內道巡撫。

translations.literal: Renchen day: Jiafu bore the staff as Hebei Circuit inspector; Xi bore the staff as Henan Circuit inspector; Chune bore the staff as Guannei Circuit inspector.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen, Zhang Jiafu was dispatched with imperial staff as Hebei Circuit inspector; Cen Xi as Henan Circuit inspector; and Ji Chune as Guannei Circuit inspector.

sentences.zh: 庚子，巨源誅。

translations.literal: Gengzi day: Juyuan was executed.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi, Wei Juyuan was put to death.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，朝邑尉劉幽求為中書舍人，苑總監鍾紹京為中書侍郎，並參豫機務。

translations.literal: Xinchou day: Chaoyi Captain Liu Youqiu became Secretariat draftsman; Park Director Zhong Shaojing Secretariat Attendant; both participated in confidential affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou, Liu Youqiu, captain of Chaoyi, was named draftsman of the Secretariat; Zhong Shaojing, park director, Secretariat Attendant; both joined in managing confidential affairs.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，紹京、黃門侍郎李日知、殿中監平王隆基並同中書門下三品。

translations.literal: Renyin day: Shaojing, Yellow Gate Attendant Li Rizhi, and Palace Domestic Office Supervisor Prince of Ping Longji all received rank equal to the Three Departments.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin, Zhong Shaojing, Li Rizhi, Yellow Gate Attendant, and Li Longji, Prince of Ping and palace domestic office supervisor, all received rank equal to the Three Departments.

sentences.zh: 至忠貶許州刺史，嗣立宋州刺史，彥昭絳州刺史，湜華州刺史。

translations.literal: Zhizhong demoted to prefect of Xu; Sili to prefect of Song; Yanzhao to prefect of Jiang; Shi to prefect of Hua.
translations.idiomatic: Xiao Zhizhong was demoted to prefect of Xu; Wei Sili to Song; Zhao Yanzhao to Jiang; and Cui Shi to Hua.

sentences.zh: 處訥、楚客、溫誅。

translations.literal: Chune, Chuke, and Wen were executed.
translations.idiomatic: Ji Chune, Zong Chuke, and Wei Wen were put to death.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，隆基同中書門下三品。

translations.literal: Guimao day: Longji received rank equal to the Three Departments.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao, Li Longji received rank equal to the Three Departments.

sentences.zh: 紹京行中書令。

translations.literal: Shaojing acted as Director of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: Zhong Shaojing served as acting Director of the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 嘉福誅。

translations.literal: Jiafu was executed.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Jiafu was put to death.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，紹京罷為戶部尚書。

translations.literal: Yisi day: Shaojing was removed and became Minister of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi, Zhong Shaojing was relieved and appointed Minister of Revenue.

sentences.zh: 丙午，太常少卿薛稷為黃門侍郎，參豫機務。

translations.literal: Bingwu day: Court of Imperial Sacrifices Vice Director Xue Ji became Yellow Gate Attendant and participated in confidential affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu, Xue Ji, court of imperial sacrifices vice director, was named Yellow Gate Attendant and joined in managing confidential affairs.

sentences.zh: 丁未，隆基為皇太子。

translations.literal: Dingwei day: Longji became crown prince.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei, Li Longji was established as crown prince.

sentences.zh: 戊申，許州刺史姚元之為兵部尚書、同中書門下三品；
