translations.literal: Wushen day: Xu Prefecture Governor Yao Yuanchong became Minister of War with rank equal to the Three Departments;
translations.idiomatic: On wushen, Yao Yuanchong, prefect of Xu, was named Minister of War with rank equal to the Three Departments;

sentences.zh: 嗣立、至忠為中書令；

translations.literal: Sili and Zhizhong became Directors of the Secretariat;
translations.idiomatic: Wei Sili and Xiao Zhizhong were named Directors of the Secretariat;

sentences.zh: 彥昭為中書侍郎，湜為吏部侍郎、同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: Yanzhao Secretariat Attendant; Shi Vice Minister of Personnel, deliberating jointly on state affairs with the Secretariat and Palace Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Yanzhao Secretariat Attendant; Cui Shi Vice Minister of Personnel, joining the Secretariat and Palace Secretariat in deliberating jointly on state affairs.

sentences.zh: 七月癸丑，兵部尚書崔日用行黃門侍郎，參知機務；

translations.literal: Seventh month, guichou day: Minister of War Cui Riyong acted as Yellow Gate Attendant and participated in knowing confidential affairs;
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, on guichou, Cui Riyong, Minister of War, served as acting Yellow Gate Attendant and joined in managing confidential affairs;

sentences.zh: 稷為中書侍郎。

translations.literal: Ji became Secretariat Attendant.
translations.idiomatic: Xue Ji was named Secretariat Attendant.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，洛州長史宋璟檢校吏部尚書同中書門下三品，元之兼太子左庶子，璟兼右庶子。

translations.literal: Dingsi day: Luozhou Chief Administrator Song Jing inspected the Ministry of Personnel with rank equal to the Three Departments; Yuanchong additionally crown prince left senior support; Jing additionally right senior support.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi, Song Jing, chief administrator of Luozhou, was made acting supervisor of the Ministry of Personnel with rank equal to the Three Departments; Yao Yuanchong additionally crown prince left senior support; Song Jing additionally right senior support.

sentences.zh: 羲罷為右散騎常侍。

translations.literal: Xi was removed and became Right Regular Attendant.
translations.idiomatic: Cen Xi was relieved and appointed Right Regular Attendant.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，湜罷為尚書左丞，錫貶絳州刺史，至忠為晉州刺史，彥昭為宋州刺史，嗣立為許州刺史。

translations.literal: Renxu day: Shi was removed and became left director of the Department of State Affairs; Xi demoted to prefect of Jiang; Zhizhong to prefect of Jin; Yanzhao to prefect of Song; Sili to prefect of Xu.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu, Cui Shi was relieved and appointed left director of the Department of State Affairs; Zhang Xi demoted to prefect of Jiang; Xiao Zhizhong to Jin; Zhao Yanzhao to Song; and Wei Sili to Xu.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，元之兼中書令，瑰為尚書左僕射。

translations.literal: Bingyin day: Yuanchong additionally Director of the Secretariat; Gui Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin, Yao Yuanchong was additionally named Director of the Secretariat; Su Gui Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs.

sentences.zh: 嶠貶為懷州刺史。

translations.literal: Jiao demoted to prefect of Huai.
translations.idiomatic: Li Jiao was demoted to prefect of Huai.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，休璟致仕，仁亶罷為左衛大將軍。

translations.literal: Dingmao day: Xiujing retired; Renbian removed and became general of the Left Guard.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao, Tang Xiujing retired; Zhang Renbian was relieved and appointed general of the Left Guard.

sentences.zh: 己巳，日用罷為雍州刺史，稷罷為左散騎常侍。

translations.literal: Jisi day: Riyong removed and became Yongzhou governor; Ji removed and became Left Regular Attendant.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi, Cui Riyong was relieved and appointed governor of Yongzhou; Xue Ji relieved and appointed Left Regular Attendant.

sentences.zh: 八月癸巳，談罷為蒲州刺史。

translations.literal: Eighth month, guisi day: Tan removed and became prefect of Pu.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on guisi, Pei Tan was relieved and appointed prefect of Pu.

sentences.zh: 十一月戊申，元崇為中書令兼兵部尚書。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, wushen day: Yuanchong became Director of the Secretariat and concurrent Minister of War.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on wushen, Yao Yuanchong was named Director of the Secretariat and concurrent Minister of War.

sentences.zh: 壬子，安石罷為太子少保，瑰罷為少傅。

translations.literal: Renzi day: Anshi removed and became junior preceptor of the crown prince; Gui removed and became junior mentor of the crown prince.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi, Wei Anshi was relieved and appointed junior preceptor of the crown prince; Su Gui junior mentor of the crown prince.

sentences.zh: 宋王成器為尚書左僕射。

translations.literal: Prince of Song Chengq became Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Prince of Song Li Chengq was appointed Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs.

sentences.zh: 六月甲申，安國相王罷參謀政事，加太尉。

translations.literal: Sixth month, jiashen day: Prince of An Guo ceased deliberating on governmental affairs and was promoted to Grand Marshal.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on jiashen, Prince of An Guo ceased deliberating on governmental affairs and was promoted to Grand Marshal.

sentences.zh: 十一月己巳，宋王成器為司徒兼揚州大都督。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, jisi day: Prince of Song Chengq became Minister of Education and concurrent Yangzhou area commander.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on jisi, Prince of Song Li Chengq was named Minister of Education and concurrent Yangzhou area commander.

sentences.zh: 正月己未，太僕卿郭元振、中書侍郎張說並同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: First month, jiwei day: Grand Herald Guo Yuanzhen and Secretariat Attendant Zhang Yue both deliberated jointly on state affairs with the Secretariat and Palace Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month, on jiwei, Guo Yuanzhen, grand herald, and Zhang Yue, Secretariat Attendant, both joined the Secretariat and Palace Secretariat in deliberating jointly on state affairs.

sentences.zh: 二月甲申，璟貶楚州刺史，元之申州刺史。

translations.literal: Second month, jiashen day: Jing demoted to prefect of Chu; Yuanchong to prefect of Shen.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on jiashen, Song Jing was demoted to prefect of Chu and Yao Yuanchong to Shen.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，韋安石為侍中，幽求罷為戶部尚書。

translations.literal: Bingxu day: Wei Anshi became Palace Secretariat Attendant; Youqiu removed and became Minister of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu, Wei Anshi was named Palace Secretariat Attendant; Liu Youqiu relieved and appointed Minister of Revenue.

sentences.zh: 四月甲申，安石為中書令。

translations.literal: Fourth month, jiashen day: Anshi became Director of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, on jiashen, Wei Anshi was named Director of the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，日知守侍中。

translations.literal: Xinmao day: Rizhi acted as Palace Secretariat Attendant.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao, Li Rizhi served as acting Palace Secretariat Attendant.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，安石加開府儀同三司。

translations.literal: Gengxu day: Anshi was promoted to Honored Companion of the First Rank.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu, Wei Anshi was promoted to honored companion of the first rank.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，殿中監竇懷貞為左臺御史大夫、同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: Renxu day: Palace Domestic Office Supervisor Dou Huaizhen became Left Terrace Censor-in-Chief and deliberated jointly on state affairs with the Secretariat and Palace Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu, Dou Huaizhen, palace domestic office supervisor, was named Left Terrace Censor-in-Chief and joined the Secretariat and Palace Secretariat in deliberating jointly on state affairs.

sentences.zh: 八月庚午，安石為尚書左僕射、同中書門下三品。

translations.literal: Eighth month, gengwu day: Anshi became Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs with rank equal to the Three Departments.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on gengwu, Wei Anshi was appointed Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs with rank equal to the Three Departments.

sentences.zh: 九月乙亥，懷貞守侍中。

translations.literal: Ninth month, yihai day: Huaizhen acted as Palace Secretariat Attendant.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on yihai, Dou Huaizhen served as acting Palace Secretariat Attendant.

sentences.zh: 十月甲辰，日知罷為戶部尚書，元振罷為吏部尚書，說罷為尚書左丞，懷貞罷為左臺御史大夫，安石罷為特進。

translations.literal: Tenth month, jiachen day: Rizhi removed and became Minister of Revenue; Yuanzhen removed and became Minister of Personnel; Yue removed and became left director of the Department of State Affairs; Huaizhen removed and became Left Terrace Censor-in-Chief; Anshi removed and became specially advanced.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, on jiachen, Li Rizhi was relieved and appointed Minister of Revenue; Guo Yuanzhen Minister of Personnel; Zhang Yue left director of the Department of State Affairs; Dou Huaizhen Left Terrace Censor-in-Chief; and Wei Anshi specially advanced.

sentences.zh: 中書侍郎陸象先同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: Secretariat Attendant Lu Xiangxian deliberated jointly on state affairs with the Secretariat and Palace Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: Lu Xiangxian, Secretariat Attendant, joined the Secretariat and Palace Secretariat in deliberating jointly on state affairs.

sentences.zh: 吏部尚書劉幽求為侍中，右散騎常侍魏知古，太子詹事崔湜為中書侍郎，並同中書門下三品。

translations.literal: Minister of Personnel Liu Youqiu Palace Secretariat Attendant; Right Regular Attendant Wei Zhigu; Crown Prince Household Administrator Cui Shi Secretariat Attendant; all with rank equal to the Three Departments.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Youqiu, Minister of Personnel, Palace Secretariat Attendant; Wei Zhigu, Right Regular Attendant; Cui Shi, crown prince household administrator and Secretariat Attendant; all with rank equal to the Three Departments.

sentences.zh: 四月甲申，宋王憲讓司徒為太子賓客。

translations.literal: Fourth month, jiashen day: Prince of Song Xian yielded the Minister of Education and became crown prince guest.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, on jiashen, Prince of Song Li Xian relinquished the minister of education and became crown prince guest.

sentences.zh: 正月壬辰，象先同中書門下三品。

translations.literal: First month, renchen day: Xiangxian received rank equal to the Three Departments.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month, on renchen, Lu Xiangxian received rank equal to the Three Departments.

sentences.zh: 乙未，竇懷貞、戶部尚書岑羲並同中書門下三品。

translations.literal: Yiwei day: Dou Huaizhen and Minister of Revenue Cen Xi both received rank equal to the Three Departments.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei, Dou Huaizhen and Cen Xi, Minister of Revenue, both received rank equal to the Three Departments.

sentences.zh: 六月癸丑，羲為侍中。

translations.literal: Sixth month, guichou day: Xi became Palace Secretariat Attendant.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on guichou, Cen Xi was named Palace Secretariat Attendant.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，知古為戶部尚書、同中書門下三品。

translations.literal: Renxu day: Zhigu became Minister of Revenue with rank equal to the Three Departments.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu, Wei Zhigu was named Minister of Revenue with rank equal to the Three Departments.

sentences.zh: 七月乙亥，懷貞為尚書右僕射、軍國重事宜共平章。

translations.literal: Seventh month, yihai day: Huaizhen became Right Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs; military and state affairs of weight were to be deliberated jointly.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, on yihai, Dou Huaizhen was appointed Right Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs, with weighty military and state affairs to be deliberated jointly.

sentences.zh: 八月庚戌，湜檢校中書令；

translations.literal: Eighth month, gengxu day: Shi inspected the Director of the Secretariat;
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on gengxu, Cui Shi was made acting supervisor of the Director of the Secretariat;

sentences.zh: 幽求守尚書右僕射，懷貞守左僕射，並同三品；

translations.literal: Youqiu acted as Right Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs; Huaizhen acted as Left Vice Director; both with rank equal to the Three Departments;
translations.idiomatic: Liu Youqiu served as acting Right Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs; Dou Huaizhen acting Left Vice Director; both with rank equal to the Three Departments;

sentences.zh: 知古守侍中。

translations.literal: Zhigu acted as Palace Secretariat Attendant.
translations.idiomatic: Wei Zhigu served as acting Palace Secretariat Attendant.

sentences.zh: 戊午，幽求流于封州。

translations.literal: Wuwu day: Youqiu was exiled to Fengzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu, Liu Youqiu was exiled to Fengzhou.

sentences.zh: 八月己酉，宋王成器為司空。

translations.literal: Eighth month, jiyou day: Prince of Song Chengq became Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on jiyou, Prince of Song Li Chengq was named Minister of Works.
